title.en: Richard Tice accuses Labour of ‘trying to change rules retrospectively’ after Reform receive £72m in donations – UK politics live
title.zh: 理查德·蒂斯指责工党在改革党收到7200万英镑捐款后“试图追溯性地改变规则”——英国政治直播

summary.en: Labour MPs and unions are pushing the government to legislate for stricter caps on political party donations. Reform UK's deputy leader, Richard Tice, has not disclosed when two crypto billionaires who collectively donated £72 million to the party returned to the UK.
summary.zh: 工党议员和工会正敦促政府立法对政治党派捐款实行更严格的上限。改革党副领袖理查德·蒂斯尚未透露向该党捐赠了7200万英镑的两名加密货币亿万富翁何时返回英国。

body.en: Labour MPs and unions are pressuring the government to legislate for a stricter cap on political party donations Richard Tice , Reform UK’s deputy leader, has declined to say when two crypto billionaires who gave a combined £72m to the party returned to the UK, Peter Walker reports. Good morning. This afternoon peers will debate the second reading of the representation of the people bill. If you hear a loud bang echo around the Lords chamber, it will be the sound of the stable door being shut after the horse has bolted. Those close to the process say capping donations is not a priority for Burnham and not a subject over which it would be worth triggering a fight with Labour’s biggest backers. We’re completely confident that [the Delo and Harborne] donations comply with not only the existing rules, but they also comply with the rules currently going through parliament, albeit with that retrospective element … Unless [Labour] literally try and change the rules again as it’s going through the House of Lords, in which case it would have to go back to the Commons. I mean, anything’s possible with this sort of dictatorship currently ruining the country. You know, we’re the victims of a coup. These donations are made in accordance with the rules and the regulations, and you’ve now got a hyperventilating hypocrisy from the socialists ruining this country, who are trying to change the rules retrospectively, which is it’s not the fair way, it’s not the British way, and I think most people will say ‘does that just mean that Labour are terrified of the progress of Reform and they’re trying to create an unlevel playing field?’ Continue reading...
body.zh: 据 Peter Walker 报道，工党议员和工会正在向政府施压，要求其立法对政党捐款实行更严格的上限。英国改革党副领袖理查德·泰斯 (Richard Tice) 拒绝透露向该党捐赠总计 7200 万英镑的两位加密货币亿万富翁何时返回英国。早上好。今天下午，议员们将就人民代表法案的二读进行辩论。如果你听到上议院议事厅周围传来一声巨响，那是马匹逃跑后马厩门关上的声音。知情人士表示，限制捐款并不是伯纳姆的首要任务，也不值得与工党最大支持者发生争执。我们完全相信，[Delo 和 Harborne] 的捐款不仅符合现有规则，而且也符合目前正在议会审议的规则，尽管有追溯的因素……除非[工党]在上议院审议时真正尝试再次更改规则，在这种情况下，它必须返回下议院。我的意思是，目前这种独裁政权正在毁掉这个国家，一切皆有可能。你知道，我们是政变的受害者。这些捐款是按照规则和规定进行的，现在你看到了那些毁掉这个国家的社会主义者的虚伪，他们试图回顾性地改变规则，这不是公平的方式，这不是英国的方式，我想大多数人会说“这是否意味着工党对改革的进展感到恐惧，他们试图创造一个不公平的竞争环境？”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The significant donation of £72 million to Reform UK has sparked debate about the rules governing political funding. This situation calls to mind the prophet Micah's timeless words: "And what does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God." The pursuit of justice in campaign finance, ensuring fairness and...
reflection.zh: 改革党收到高达7200万英镑的巨额捐款，引发了关于政治资金管理规则的辩论。这一情况令人想起先知弥迦永恒的话语：“雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。”在竞选资金方面追求公正，确保公平和透明，是合乎道德的治理的重要方面。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Queen’s secret Whitlam correspondence inspires Sydney Theatre Company play in 2027
title.zh: 女王与惠特拉姆的秘密通信启发了2027年悉尼剧院公司戏剧

summary.en: The Sydney Theatre Company's 2027 program will feature a play based on secret correspondence between Queen Elizabeth II, Malcolm Fraser, and Governor-General John Kerr, concerning the dismissal of Prime Minister Gough Whitlam. Historian Jenny Hocking's legal battle to release these 'Palace Letters' led to the...
summary.zh: 悉尼剧院公司2027年的节目将包括一部根据女王伊丽莎白二世、马尔科姆·弗雷泽和总督约翰·克尔之间关于罢免总理戈夫·惠特拉姆的秘密通信改编的戏剧。历史学家珍妮·霍金赢得法律诉讼以公开这些“宫廷信件”的斗争促成了此次改编，该剧将在悉尼歌剧院首演，由乔治·帕克饰演霍金，乔纳森·比金斯饰演惠特拉姆。

body.en: STC’s 2027 program also features Celeste Barber in Amy Sedaris and David Sedaris play, Tim Minchin as Scrooge and the return of The Picture of Dorian Gray Six years after the Australian historian Jenny Hocking won her legal battle to release secret correspondence between Queen Elizabeth II, Malcolm Fraser and the governor general John Kerr, her fight to reveal the truth about Gough Whitlam’s dismissal is being adapted for the stage. The Palace Letters, announced on Monday as part of Sydney Theatre Company’s 2027 program, will have its world premiere at Sydney Opera House in April. It will star Georgie Parker as Hocking, with Jonathan Biggins playing Whitlam. Continue reading...
body.zh: STC 2027 年的节目还包括塞莱斯特·巴伯 (Celeste Barber) 在艾米·塞达里斯 (Amy Sedaris) 和大卫·塞达里斯 (David Sedaris) 中扮演斯克鲁奇，蒂姆·明钦 (Tim Minchin) 饰演斯克鲁奇，以及《道林·格雷的画像》(The Picture of Dorian Gray) 的回归。六年前，澳大利亚历史学家珍妮·霍金 (Jenny Hocking) 赢得了公开伊丽莎白二世女王、马尔科姆·弗雷泽 (Malcolm Fraser) 和总督约翰·克尔 (John Kerr) 之间秘密信件的法律诉讼，而她为揭露高夫·惠特拉姆 (Gough Whitlam) 被解雇真相而进行的斗争正在被改编成舞台剧。作为悉尼剧院公司 2027 年计划的一部分，周一宣布的《宫殿信件》将于 4 月在悉尼歌剧院进行全球首演。乔吉·帕克将饰演霍金，乔纳森·比金斯将饰演惠特拉姆。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The release and dramatization of "The Palace Letters" bring to light historical communications that shaped a nation's political landscape. This reminds us of the profound responsibility leaders bear, as Jeremiah declared, 'Do justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who is plundered.' The stage becomes a forum to examine how...
reflection.zh: “宫廷信件”的公开和戏剧化，揭示了塑造国家政治格局的历史通信。这让我们想起领导人所承担的重大责任，正如耶利米所宣告的：“你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手。”舞台成为了审视权力和真相如何交织的论坛，促使人们反思问责制。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Reform declines to say if £72m donors returned to UK within 12-month limit
title.zh: 改革党拒绝说明7200万英镑捐款者是否在12个月内返回英国

summary.en: Reform UK's deputy leader, Richard Tice, has declined to specify when two crypto billionaires, who collectively donated £72 million to the party, returned to the UK. This comes as the architect of a review into overseas donations stated that rules would be applied retrospectively, meaning individuals present for less...
summary.zh: 改革党副领袖理查德·泰斯拒绝说明向该党捐赠共计7200万英镑的两名加密货币亿万富翁何时返回英国。此前，一项关于海外捐款审查的负责人表示，相关规定将追溯适用，这意味着在英国居住未满12个月的人将受到捐款限制。泰斯表示，他对改革党遵守现行及拟议法律充满信心，但无法提供本·德洛返回英国的日期，也无法说明常居泰国的克里斯托弗·...

body.en: Richard Tice says contributions are legally compliant after author of review into overseas donations says rules will be applied retrospectively Reform UK’s deputy leader has declined to say when two crypto billionaires who gave a combined £72m to the party returned to the UK, as the architect of a review into overseas donations said anyone here for less than 12 months would be subject to a limit on donations. Richard Tice said that while he was completely confident Reform had complied with all current and proposed laws on donations, he could not say when Ben Delo returned to the UK from Hong Kong, or how much time the Thailand-based Christopher Harborne spent in Britain. Continue reading...
body.zh: 理查德·泰斯 (Richard Tice) 表示，海外捐款审查的作者表示规则将追溯适用，改革英国的副领导人拒绝透露向该党捐赠了 7200 万英镑的两位加密货币亿万富翁何时返回英国，因为海外捐款审查的设计者表示，任何在英国居住时间少于 12 个月的人都将受到捐款限制。理查德·泰斯表示，虽然他完全有信心改革会遵守所有现行和拟议的捐赠法律，但他无法透露本·德洛何时从香港返回英国，也不能透露泰国的克里斯托弗·哈博恩在英国呆了多长时间。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The integrity of political funding is crucial for public trust. When questions arise about the source and timing of large donations, as with Reform UK's £72 million, it touches upon the core principles of accountability and transparency. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to love mercy,' reminding us that ethical conduct, especially in public life, is...
reflection.zh: 政治资金的诚信对于公众信任至关重要。当出现关于巨额捐款来源和时间的疑问时，例如改革党收到的7200万英镑，这触及了问责制和透明度的核心原则。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们“施行公义，喜爱怜悯”，提醒我们，尤其是在公共生活中，道德行为是至高无上的。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: UK ministers urged to act after US flies out diplomat accused of possessing indecent images of children
title.zh: 美国被指控持有儿童不雅图像的外交官被飞离英国，英国大臣被敦促采取行动

summary.en: British ministers are facing calls to take action after US authorities reportedly removed a diplomat accused of possessing indecent images of children from the UK. The diplomat's London home was allegedly raided by US officials last month, and he was then taken to an American airbase and flown out of the country...
summary.zh: 据报道，在美国当局将一名被指控持有儿童不雅图像的外交官秘密带离英国后，英国大臣们正面临采取行动的呼吁。据称，该外交官的伦敦住所上个月被美国官员搜查，随后他被带往一个美国空军基地并被飞离该国，而未通知苏格兰场。

body.en: US officials reportedly raided envoy’s London home and took him to American airbase without warning Met police UK politics live – latest updates British ministers face calls to act after US authorities secretly flew out of the UK a diplomat accused of possessing indecent images of children. US officials reportedly raided the diplomat’s London flat last month before taking him to an American airbase and flying him out of the country, without warning the Metropolitan police. Continue reading...
body.zh: 据报道，美国官员突袭了特使在伦敦的住所，并在没有警告的情况下将他带到了美国空军基地。 大都会警察局对英国政治进行现场直播——最新消息在美国当局秘密用飞机离开英国后，英国部长们面临采取行动的呼声，一名被指控拥有儿童不雅图片的外交官。据报道，美国官员上个月突击搜查了这名外交官在伦敦的公寓，然后将他带到美国空军基地，并在没有通知伦敦警察厅的情况下将他带出该国。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of a diplomat accused of grave offenses being removed from the UK without the knowledge of local authorities raises serious questions about justice and accountability. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute." This principle urges us to consider the vulnerable and...
reflection.zh: 一名被指控犯下严重罪行的外交官在未告知当地当局的情况下被带离英国的消息，引发了关于正义和问责制的严肃问题。《箴言》31:8-9 呼吁我们“为不能说话的开口，为所有孤苦者辩屈。”这一原则敦促我们要顾念弱势群体，并确保正义得到伸张，尤其是在强大势力秘密行事的时候。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Malaysian boy acquitted for murder of schoolgirl on grounds of insanity
title.zh: 马来西亚男孩因精神失常谋杀女同学案获无罪释放

summary.en: A Malaysian teenage boy charged with the murder of a schoolmate has been acquitted, with the judge finding the boy was mentally unsound during the incident. The killing of the 16-year-old girl had shocked Malaysia and sparked debate about the effects of social media on children.
summary.zh: 一名被控谋杀女同学的马来西亚少年已被宣告无罪，法官认定该男孩在事发时精神失常。这名16岁女孩的遇害震惊了马来西亚，并引发了关于社交媒体对儿童影响的辩论。

body.en:
A Malaysian teenage boy charged with the high-profile murder of a female schoolmate has been acquitted, with the judge finding the boy was mentally unsound during the incident.

He had fatally stabbed Yap Shing Xuen in a toilet at their secondary school on the outskirts of the capital Kuala Lumpur.

The killing of the 16-year-old girl had shocked Malaysia and sparked debate about the effects of social media on children.

Police previously had said they suspected social media could have influenced the boy, who was 14 at the time. The case was seen to have spurred authorities to limit children's access to social media, which began earlier this year.

The boy - who cannot be named under Malaysian law as he is still a minor - had pleaded not guilty to the murder charge.

During the trial defence lawyers did not deny that the boy killed the girl, but argued that he had suffered from poor mental health for years and asked for his acquittal on the grounds of insanity.

An expert witness, a psychiatrist, testified that the boy had schizophrenia, and had suffered from mental illness and experienced delusions since he was nine years old.

The boy's condition was said to have worsened during the pandemic and when he eventually returned to school. Lawyers had said that the boy would need medication for the rest of his life to manage symptoms.

On Monday the judge ruled that the boy would be acquitted, but also ordered for him to be detained and to receive treatment at a psychiatric hospital.

He will stay at the hospital until he is deemed fit to be released back to society, and would likely be subject to yearly assessments.

A defence lawyer told reporters on Monday that upon hearing the verdict, the boy appeared "neutral in emotion, but he understands what is going on, [that] it's a very serious matter".

The trial and verdict hearings were held in a closed court, which meant that the public and media could not attend.

The case has profoundly shocked Malaysia and sparked a nationwide conversation about the negative effects of social media on children.

Much of this conversation was triggered by the contents of a note that police had found on the boy at the time of his arrest, which was leaked online and widely circulated.

Some people had compared the case to the Netflix series Adolescence, which featured a storyline about a young boy killing a female schoolmate and explored the theme of online radicalisation.

Last year, the country's Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim was asked about the case as well as other recent cases of violence in schools.

He was quoted by local media as saying that "almost all of these issues stem from the use of mobile phones and social media", and vowed to look into stricter measures.

Authorities have since put in place new rules...
body.zh: 一名被指控高调谋杀女同学的马来西亚少年被无罪释放，法官发现该男孩在事件中精神不健全。 他在首都吉隆坡郊区中学的厕所里刺死了叶成学。 这名 16 岁女孩被杀震惊了马来西亚，并引发了关于社交媒体对儿童影响的辩论。 警方此前曾表示，他们怀疑社交媒体可能影响了这名当时 14 岁的男孩。这起案件似乎促使当局从今年早些时候开始限制儿童使用社交媒体。 这名男孩——根据马来西亚法律，他的名字不能被透露，因为他还是未成年人——对谋杀指控表示不认罪。 庭审期间，辩护律师并未否认男孩杀害了女孩，但辩称男孩多年来精神健康状况不佳，并以精神错乱为由要求无罪释放。 专家证人、精神科医生证实，男孩患有精神分裂症，从九岁起就患有精神疾病，出现妄想症。 据说，在大流行期间以及最终返回学校后，男孩的病情恶化了。律师表示，男孩的余生都需要药物来控制症状。 周一，法官裁定男孩无罪释放，但同时下令将他拘留并在精神病院接受治疗。 他将留在医院，直到被认为适合出院返回社会，并且可能会接受年度评估。 一名辩护律师周一告诉记者，听到判决后，男孩“情绪中立，但他明白发生了什么，这是一件非常严重的事情”。 庭审和判决听证会在法庭不公开进行，这意味着公众和媒体无法旁听。 此案震惊了马来西亚，并引发了全国范围内关于社交媒体对儿童负面影响的讨论。 这次谈话的大部分内容是由警方在男孩被捕时发现的一张纸条内容引发的，该纸条已在网上泄露并广泛传播。 有人将此案与 Netflix 的电视剧《青春期》进行比较，该剧讲述了一个小男孩杀死一名女同学的故事，并探讨了网络激进化的主题。 去年，该国总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣被问及此案以及最近发生的其他校园暴力案件。 当地媒体援引他的话说，“几乎所有这些问题都源于手机和社交媒体的使用”，并誓言要采取更严格的措施。 此后当局制定了新规则......

reflection.en: This case highlights the tragic intersection of mental health and violence. The court's decision to acquit the boy on grounds of insanity underscores the need for compassion and understanding towards those struggling with mental unsoundness. It is a somber reminder that healing and restoration, rather than retribution, are often the path toward addressing...
reflection.zh: 此案凸显了精神健康与暴力之间悲剧性的交汇点。法院以精神失常为由宣告该男孩无罪的判决，强调了对那些饱受精神困扰者应有的同情与理解。这是一个令人警醒的提醒，即治愈与恢复，而非报复，往往是解决如此深刻破碎的途径。

verse.textEn: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons, sitting there, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
verse.textZh: 他们来到耶稣那里，看见那被鬼附着的人，就是从前被群鬼所附的，坐着，穿上衣服，心里明白过来，他们就害怕。

title.en: Indonesian police investigate deaths of Australian man and two children in Bali as suspected murder-suicide
title.zh: 印尼警方调查澳大利亚男子及两名儿童死亡事件，疑为谋杀后自杀

summary.en: Police in Bali are investigating the deaths of three Australians, including a 57-year-old man and two children aged seven and four. Initial findings suggest the man killed his children before taking his own life. The victims were discovered in a bungalow in Kuta on Sunday.
summary.zh: 印尼巴厘岛警方正在调查三名澳大利亚人死亡的事件，其中包括一名57岁的男子和两名分别为七岁和四岁的儿童。初步调查显示，该男子在自杀前杀害了自己的孩子。三名死者于周日被发现在库塔的一处平房内。

body.en: Police in Bali believe the two young children died as a result of violence, while a 57-year-old man is believed to have taken his own life Indonesian police are investigating the deaths of three Australians who died in Bali over the weekend, with initial reports suggesting a father killed his two young children before taking his own life. The man, 57, and his two children, seven and four, who are also Indonesian citizens, were discovered deceased in a bungalow in Kuta on Sunday morning. Continue reading...
body.zh: 巴厘岛警方认为，这两名年幼的孩子死于暴力，而一名 57 岁的男子据信自杀了。印度尼西亚警方正在调查周末在巴厘岛死亡的三名澳大利亚人的死亡事件，初步报告显示，一名父亲在自杀前杀死了他的两个年幼的孩子。周日早上，这名 57 岁的男子和他的两个孩子（七岁和四岁）被发现死在库塔的一间平房里，他们也是印度尼西亚公民。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news from Bali is a stark reminder of the profound vulnerability of children and the devastating consequences of violence within families. Isaiah 1:17 calls us to defend the oppressed, to seek justice for the fatherless, and to plead for the widow. In the face of such tragedy, we are called to lament the loss and to pray for healing and protection for...
reflection.zh: 巴厘岛传来的消息令人痛心，它警示我们儿童是多么脆弱，以及家庭暴力会带来多么毁灭性的后果。以赛亚书1章17节呼吁我们为孤儿伸冤，为寡妇争理。面对如此悲剧，我们被呼召为逝去的生命哀恸，并为所有弱势群体祈求医治与保护。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call
title.zh: 瑞典大选两党势均力敌，结果难分轩轾

summary.en: Sweden's two main political blocs are virtually tied after Sunday's election, with projections showing a razor-thin margin of only 20,000 votes separating them as half the votes have been counted.
summary.zh: 瑞典周日大选后，两大政治阵营势均力敌，初步计票结果显示，在已统计的半数选票中，两大阵营仅相差2万票。

body.en:
Sweden's general election remains too close to call with the left-wing bloc marginally ahead as the vote count continues.

With more than 90% of ballots processed early on Monday, the left-wing bloc was in front by approximately 20,000 votes.

Preliminary counts by Sweden's electoral authority projected the Social Democrats' Magdalena Andersson would likely finish with a three-seat majority over the rival four-party coalition led by current conservative Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson.

Kristersson has been supported in government by the hard-right Sweden Democrats (SD), which have neo-Nazi roots. He has promised cabinet jobs for the SD if he stays in charge.

Early on Monday morning, Kristersson said it remained unclear who would form the next government.

"The voters have had their say, but we still don't have a final result. Which government will lead Sweden in the coming years is still an open question," he told supporters.

Sweden uses a mandate distribution voting system, a proportional representation method to elect "mandates", or "seats", in the Riksdag – the Swedish parliament. A party needs at least 4% of the vote to enter parliament.

With 95% of votes reported, the left-wing bloc led by the Social Democrats was ahead with 176 mandates compared to the right-wing bloc's 173.

Counting will continue on Wednesday before the final results determine which side has a clearer path to majority.

The counting restarts then to include early votes that were submitted late, as well as votes from abroad that did not arrive before election day.

It is not yet known how many votes will be counted on Wednesday, but back in 2022, more than 220,000 votes were included in the later count.

If the figures are similar this year, Wednesday's count could make the difference in the outcome, given that only about 28,000 votes currently separate the blocs.

Sweden has two major political blocs featuring four parties on the right and four on the left - meaning coalition and minority governments are relatively common.

On Sunday night, Andersson - the leader of the country's main opposition party - urged supporters to wait for the final result, but added that if the current results hold, "Sweden will have a new government."

Her party, the Social Democrats, have been a major force in Swedish politics since the end of World War Two.

But SD - founded by Nazi sympathisers in the 1980s - had been shunned for years until 2022 when it became the country's second largest party after campaigning on violent crime and immigration.

Both Andersson's party and the far-right SD have lost support, according to early count results.

As of Monday morning, the Social Democrats were on track for their worst result in more than a century with 28 per cent, while the count showed the...
body.zh: 瑞典公共广播公司 SVT 表示，50% 的选票已清点完毕，两大集团的票数仅相差 20,000 张。 出口民意调查显示，社会民主党领袖马格达莱娜·安德森领导的左翼政治集团略微领先于现任保守党总理乌尔夫·克里斯特森组建的竞争对手四党联盟。 克里斯特森在政府中得到了具有新纳粹根源的极右翼瑞典民主党（SD）的支持。他承诺，如果他继续执政，将为社会民主党提供内阁职位，但部分结果显示，该党自 2010 年进入议会以来首次失去支持。 瑞典有两个主要政治集团，其中有四个右翼政党和四个左翼政党，这意味着联合政府和少数派政府相对常见。 自第二次世界大战结束以来，安德森领导的社会民主党一直是瑞典政治的主要力量。 但由纳粹同情者在 1980 年代创立的社会民主党多年来一直受到回避，直到 2022 年，该党在针对暴力犯罪和移民问题开展竞选活动后成为该国第二大政党。 周日投票后，安德森向瑞典公众做出了选择：“我们应该建立一个完全由瑞典民主党主导的政府，这在瑞典以前从未发生过吗？还是应该建立一个由我领导的政府，以新的合作精神引导瑞典？” 克里斯特森则表示，他和他的联盟能够继续他们的工作非常重要。 他在家乡斯特兰纳斯市投票后表示：“我认为我们对能够继续我们的重要工作抱有真正的热情。” 国家安全、帮派犯罪和福利支出主导了竞选活动。

reflection.en: In Sweden, the election results are so close that the outcome remains uncertain, highlighting the precariousness of political power. This reminds us that ultimate authority rests with Yahweh, who raises leaders and brings them down according to His purposes. We pray for wisdom and humility for all involved, trusting in His sovereign hand.
reflection.zh: 在瑞典，选举结果如此接近，以至于最终结果仍不明朗，这凸显了政治权力的不确定性。这提醒我们，最终的权柄在于雅伟，祂按祂的旨意高举领袖，也使他们衰落。我们祈求智慧与谦卑临到所有相关人员，并信靠祂的主权之手。

verse.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verse.textZh: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

title.en: Can Iran replace sea trade with land routes?
title.zh: 伊朗能否用陆路取代海运贸易？

summary.en: Iran is rerouting trade through northern ports and land routes due to a US blockade on its southern shipping. While analysts believe these corridors can maintain the flow of essential goods, they cannot fully substitute for maritime trade.
summary.zh: 由于美国封锁了其南部航运，伊朗正通过北部港口和陆路改道贸易。分析人士认为，这些通道可以维持必需品的流通，但无法完全取代海上贸易。

body.en:
Iran is shifting trade toward northern ports and land routes as its southern shipping faces a US blockade. Analysts say the corridors can keep essential goods moving, but cannot replace maritime trade.

Can land corridors offset the impact of the maritime blockade on Iran ? The US-led maritime blockade targeting Iranian ports has severely disrupted trade through its southern ports, but it is also accelerating a strategy Tehran had discussed for years: moving more commerce through northern ports, railways and land corridors.

Economy Minister Ali Madanizadeh, visiting Moscow for talks with Russian officials, said Iran should activate its northern borders and shift a significant share of imports and exports away from the country's southern maritime routes .

The idea is straightforward. Iran has seven land neighbors, access to the Caspian Sea and several routes linking it to Russia, Central Asia, Turkey, Iraq, Pakistan and the Caucasus. In theory, that gives Tehran more options than a country dependent on a single maritime gateway.

The question is whether those routes have enough capacity to replace what is being lost at sea.

Alireza Salavati, a London-based political economy commentator, told DW that Iran does have unused capacity.

"Iran has more room to maneuver than its dependence on southern ports might suggest,” he said.

Iranian authorities said in late 2025 that the country's northern ports had more than 30 million tons of nominal annual capacity, with less than one-third in use. That suggests room for more grain, food and general cargo through the Caspian Sea.

Turkey provides another route toward Europe. Rail freight between Iran and Turkey depends partly on train ferries across Lake Van, which carried about 477,000 tons in 2024.

To the northeast, Sarakhs and Incheh Borun connect Iran through Turkmenistan toward Central Asia, Russia and potentially China. To the northwest, Astara is part of the International North-South Transport Corridor linking Iran to Azerbaijan and Russia, he said.

The Astara freight terminal is designed for 3.5 to 4 million tons a year, but handled only about 345,000 tons in the first five months of 2026. The unfinished Rasht-Astara rail link remains an important bottleneck.

For specific goods, these routes matter. Grain from Russia and Kazakhstan, medicines, industrial inputs and regional trade can be redirected more easily than crude oil. 

Jafar Ghaderi, a member of Iranian parliament's Economic Commission, recently said that 83% of what he described as Iran's 210 million tons of imports had traditionally moved through southern maritime borders, a tremendous volume of goods. 

"Whenever we are under a maritime blockade, we face problems," hhe said. "How much capacity do our eastern,...
body.zh: 随着伊朗南部航运面临美国封锁，伊朗正在将贸易转向北部港口和陆路。分析人士表示，这些走廊可以保持必需品的流通，但无法取代海上贸易。 陆地走廊能否抵消海上封锁对伊朗的影响？美国领导的针对伊朗港口的海上封锁严重扰乱了通过其南部港口的贸易，但它也加速了德黑兰多年来讨论的一项战略：通过北部港口、铁路和陆地走廊转移更多的商业。 正在访问莫斯科与俄罗斯官员会谈的经济部长阿里·马达尼扎德表示，伊朗应激活其北部边境，并将很大一部分进出口贸易从该国南部海上航线转移出去。 这个想法很简单。伊朗有七个陆地邻国，拥有通往里海的通道以及几条连接俄罗斯、中亚、土耳其、伊拉克、巴基斯坦和高加索地区的航线。从理论上讲，这为德黑兰提供了比依赖单一海上门户的国家更多的选择。 问题是这些航线是否有足够的能力来弥补海上损失的能力。 伦敦政治经济评论员阿里雷扎·萨拉瓦蒂 (Alireza Salavati) 告诉德国之声，伊朗确实有闲置产能。 “伊朗拥有比其对南部港口的依赖所暗示的更大的回旋余地，”他说。 伊朗当局在 2025 年底表示，该国北部港口的名义年吞吐量超过 3000 万吨，但使用率不足三分之一。这表明里海有更多的粮食、食品和普通货物运输的空间。 土耳其提供了另一条通往欧洲的路线。伊朗和土耳其之间的铁路货运部分依赖于凡湖上的火车渡轮，2024 年运载量约为 477,000 吨。 在东北部，萨拉赫斯和英杰博伦将伊朗通过土库曼斯坦连接到中亚、俄罗斯，可能还有中国。他说，在西北部，阿斯塔拉是连接伊朗、阿塞拜疆和俄罗斯的国际南北运输走廊的一部分。 阿斯塔拉货运站的设计年吞吐量为3.5至400万吨，但2026年前5个月仅处理约34.5万吨。未完工的拉什特-阿斯塔拉铁路线仍然是一个重要瓶颈。 对于特定货物来说，这些路线很重要。来自俄罗斯和哈萨克斯坦的谷物、药品、工业投入和区域贸易比原油更容易重新调整方向。 伊朗议会经济委员会成员贾法尔·加德里(Jafar Ghaderi)最近表示，他所说的伊朗2.1亿吨进口货物中的83%传统上都是通过南部海上边界运输的，这是一个巨大的货物量。 “每当我们受到海上封锁时，我们都会遇到问题，”他说。 “我们东部有多少产能……

reflection.en: Facing international sanctions, Iran is strategically pivoting its trade to land routes. This move highlights a nation's effort to navigate complex geopolitical challenges and ensure economic continuity. It echoes the principle of committing one's plans to divine oversight, trusting that Yahweh will establish their endeavors.
reflection.zh: 面对国际制裁，伊朗正将其贸易战略性地转向陆路。这一举措凸显了一个国家为应对复杂的地缘政治挑战并确保经济连续性所做的努力。这呼应了将计划交托给神圣指引的原则，相信雅伟将成就他们的事业。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Bali police investigate after Australian man and children found dead in home
title.zh: 巴厘岛警方调查澳籍男子及子女在家中身亡事件

summary.en: Police were called to a home in Bali after the wife of an Australian man became concerned and asked neighbours to check on her family. The bodies of the man and his two young children were subsequently found dead.
summary.zh: 警方接到报案，因一名澳大利亚男子的妻子感到担忧，请邻居前去查看其家中情况。随后，该男子及其两个年幼子女的遗体在家中被发现。

body.en:
Police in Bali are investigating after the bodies of an Australian man and his two children were found dead in their bungalow in a popular tourist area.

Damien John Shaw, 56, and his two children, a boy aged six and a girl aged four, were found dead in their home in Kuta on Sunday.

Police said neighbours had checked in on the family after a call from the man's wife, who had become concerned after a phone call with her husband. She was not in Bali at the time.

Australian media reported that police were treating the case as a suspected murder-suicide. Police told the BBC they had not yet determined the cause or manner of death and that further examinations would be carried out.

Police said the man's wife had called a neighbour after hearing one of her children crying while on the phone to her husband. She was subsequently unable to contact him again.

Police said that the neighbour, accompanied by other local residents, had then forced their way into the property after there was no response to their knocks. The three victims were discovered inside.

Police said Shaw was originally from Fremantle in Western Australia. Roger Cook, the state's premier, described the news as a "very confronting situation".

"This is a very sad situation; our hearts go out to everyone involved. We hope we can get to the bottom of what's gone on as soon as possible," he added.
body.zh: 巴厘岛警方正在调查一名澳大利亚男子及其两个孩子的尸体被发现死在热门旅游区的平房内。 周日，56 岁的达米安·约翰·肖 (Damien John Shaw) 和他的两个孩子（一个六岁的男孩和一个四岁的女孩）被发现死在库塔的家中。 警方表示，在该男子的妻子打来电话后，邻居们对这家人进行了检查，她在与丈夫通了电话后感到担忧。当时她不在巴厘岛。 澳大利亚媒体报道称，警方将此案视为疑似谋杀自杀案。警方告诉英国广播公司，他们尚未确定死因或方式，并将进行进一步检查。 警方称，该男子的妻子在给丈夫打电话时听到自己的一个孩子在哭，于是给邻居打了电话。随后她就无法再联系到他了。 警方表示，邻居敲门无人回应，随后在其他当地居民的陪同下强行闯入该住宅。三名受害者是在里面被发现的。 警方称肖来自西澳大利亚弗里曼特尔。该州州长罗杰·库克将这一消息描述为“非常严峻的形势”。 “这是一个非常悲伤的情况；我们的心与所有相关人员同在。我们希望能够尽快查明事情的真相，”他补充道。

reflection.en: The tragic discovery of a father and his two young children in Bali is a stark reminder of the vulnerability of families and the devastating impact of violence within the home. The call to defend the oppressed, especially the most defenseless among us, resonates deeply in such moments of profound loss and unanswered questions.
reflection.zh: 在巴厘岛发现一名父亲及其两个年幼子女不幸身亡的悲剧，令人痛心地提醒我们家庭的脆弱性以及家庭暴力带来的毁灭性影响。在如此深切的失落和未解之谜面前，保护受压迫者，尤其是我们中最无助者的呼声，显得尤为沉重。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: A 'winner-takes-all race' that could end in catastrophe, and the calls to slow it down
title.zh: 一场可能导致灾难的“赢者通吃”竞赛，以及要求放缓的呼声

summary.en: Frontier AI companies are raising alarms about the rapid pace of their own industry's development, with leaders calling for a slowdown to implement better safety measures and guardrails.
summary.zh: 世界前沿的人工智能公司正在对自身行业的发展速度敲响警钟，领导者们呼吁放缓步伐，以实施更完善的安全措施和保障措施。

body.en:
It sounds like science fiction — or the stuff of nightmares — as some of the biggest names in artificial intelligence warn that the technology their own companies are developing could go seriously wrong without an urgent slowdown.

Over the weekend, Anthropic boss Dario Amodei published an online essay calling for a coordinated reduction in the pace of AI development in order to give companies and governments more time to establish better guardrails.

While those concerns have existed for years, Amodei said events in recent months — including the Hugging Face AI hacking incident — had convinced him that action was needed.

Some experts have described that incident as a wake-up call that provided a concrete demonstration of the safety risks they had long warned about.

Amodei reportedly left industry giant Open AI over ethical concerns and co-founded Anthropic, another large US AI company that operates the popular Claude chatbot.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I believe that if slowing down bought us even an extra year or two before models reach critical levels of capability, and we used that time to advance alignment, we could greatly reduce the risk that something goes seriously wrong," Amodei wrote.

Key among Amodei's concerns was so-called "recursive self-improvement", where AI becomes capable of improving AI, potentially creating a cycle of increasingly powerful systems that outrun human ability to understand or control them.

The leaders of two rival AI companies, OpenAI's Sam Altman and xAI's Elon Musk, both voiced their agreement.

Alarm about the potentially existential risks posed by AI grew after an Anthropic researcher resigned last week, stating that "people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade".

If some of the industry's biggest players agree that AI development should slow down, what would that look like — and is it even possible?

It depends who you ask. United States President Donald Trump brushed off calls to check the development of AI and suggestions that the technology is moving too quickly, attributing those warnings to "negative forces".

"We're leading China on AI ... and, frankly, I want to keep it that way because whoever wins AI, wins," he said over the weekend.

Experts say AI leaders may be genuinely concerned about the technology's consequences, yet they are also motivated to rapidly advance out of fear their competitors will outpace them.

Geoff Webb, an Australian laureate fellow in the Monash University Department of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, told SBS News he doesn't think it's "remotely feasible" that AI companies...
body.zh: 这听起来像是科幻小说，或者是噩梦，因为人工智能领域的一些知名人士警告说，如果不紧急放慢速度，他们自己公司正在开发的技术可能会出现严重错误。 周末，Anthropic 老板达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 在网上发表了一篇文章，呼吁协调一致地放慢人工智能的发展速度，以便给企业和政府更多的时间来建立更好的护栏。 尽管这些担忧已经存在多年，但阿莫迪表示，最近几个月发生的事件——包括 Hugging Face AI 黑客事件——让他确信需要采取行动。 一些专家将这一事件描述为一记警钟，具体展示了他们长期以来警告的安全风险。 据报道，Amodei 因道德问题离开了行业巨头 Open AI，并与他人共同创立了另一家美国大型人工智能公司 Anthropic，该公司运营广受欢迎的 Claude 聊天机器人。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 阿莫迪写道：“我相信，如果放慢速度，让我们在模型达到关键能力水平之前多花一两年的时间，并且我们利用这段时间来推进调整，我们就可以大大降低出现严重错误的风险。” 阿莫迪担心的关键是所谓的“递归自我改进”，即人工智能能够改进人工智能，有可能创造一个日益强大的系统的循环，超出人类理解或控制它们的能力。 两家竞争对手人工智能公司的领导人 OpenAI 的 Sam Altman 和 xAI 的 Elon Musk 都表示同意。 上周，一位人类研究人员辞职后，人们对人工智能带来的潜在生存风险的警觉越来越强烈，他表示“构建人工智能的人们真诚地相信，到本世纪末，它可能会杀死我们所有人”。 如果该行业的一些最大参与者同意人工智能发展应该放缓，那会是什么样子——这有可能吗？ 这取决于你问谁。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对检查人工智能发展的呼吁以及该技术发展太快的建议不予理睬，将这些警告归因于“负面力量”。 他周末表示：“我们在人工智能方面领先中国……坦率地说，我希望保持这种状态，因为谁赢得了人工智能，谁就获胜了。” 专家表示，人工智能领导者可能真正担心该技术的后果，但他们也担心竞争对手会超过他们，因此也有动力快速前进。 莫纳什大学数据科学与人工智能系的澳大利亚获奖者杰夫·韦伯 (Geoff Webb) 告诉 SBS 新闻，他认为人工智能公司“遥不可及”……

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, described as a 'winner-takes-all race,' carries echoes of the Tower of Babel story. In Genesis 11, humanity's unified ambition to reach the heavens led to divine intervention and confusion. Today's AI race, while driven by innovation, also prompts urgent calls for caution and regulation to prevent unintended...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展，被形容为一场“赢者通吃”的竞赛，让人联想到《创世记》中巴别塔的故事。在创世记11章中，人类统一的野心试图通天，最终导致了神的干预和混乱。如今的人工智能竞赛，虽然由创新驱动，但也引发了对谨慎和监管的紧急呼吁，以防止意想不到的后果。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Hyrox athlete sparks debate for continuing race after soiling herself
title.zh: Hyrox运动员在如厕后继续比赛引发争议

summary.en: An athlete's decision to continue a Hyrox race in Beijing after soiling herself has ignited a debate, with some questioning hygiene standards and others commending her determination. Race organizers conducted a cleanup, and the company urged against directing frustration at the athlete.
summary.zh: 一名运动员在北京的Hyrox比赛中，在途中失禁后仍坚持完成比赛，引发了争议。一些人质疑卫生标准，另一些人则赞扬她的决心。赛事组织者进行了清理，该公司呼吁不要将不满指向运动员本人。

body.en:
An athlete's Hyrox performance has sparked debate after completing a race in Beijing despite soiling herself midway through the event.

Footage of the woman competing in the indoor fitness competition despite her soiled legs has gone viral, with some people raising concerns around hygiene and others saluting her resolve to push through. Some also criticised race organisers for letting her to continue.

Hyrox said they launched a "major cleanup operation" after the event on Saturday, including by sanitising equipment and replacing sections of the carpet.

The German fitness company acknowledged the "legitimate concerns" but urged people not to direct their frustration at the athlete herself.

The company did not reveal the woman's identity, but it was revealed online and she subsequently received threats of violence.

"There is no place in our community for threats of violence or encouragement to harm an athlete," Hyrox said in a statement early on Monday.

"Any person identified as engaging in this behaviour – whether through comments, direct messages or social media – will be permanently banned from all Hyrox events," it said.

Some participants in the same event had demanded an apology and a refund, arguing that they were forced to come into contact with contaminated equipment, Chinese media reported.

In each Hyrox race, participants alternate between running a kilometre and doing fitness exercises, such as the sled push, burpee jumps, indoor rowing, and lunges while carrying a sandbag.

The competition has exploded in popularity since it was founded in 2017 in Hamburg, Germany, and is now held across the world. The sport debuted in mainland China in late 2024.

Some have questioned why those officiating the competition in Beijing last weekend did not intervene when the athlete soiled herself, given that Hyrox penalises acts including spitting and littering.

"From a basic health and sanitation standpoint, the athlete should have been stopped immediately, and any contaminated areas should have been closed off and properly cleaned before other athletes were allowed through," Erica Dodge, a US-based nurse, wrote in a comment on Instagram.

Joe Ho, who also took part in the Hyrox Beijing competition over the weekend, has criticised Hyrox's response to the issue and called on the organisation to "take responsibility when its own procedures fail".

"If the organisation accepts that something went wrong, why not offer affected participants refunds, credits, or some meaningful form of compensation?" he wrote.

Others in the fitness community have pointed out that this is not unheard of for endurance athletes.

body.zh: 一名运动员在北京完成一场比赛后，尽管在比赛中途弄脏了自己，但她的 Hyrox 表现引发了争议。 这名女子不顾双腿脏兮兮参加室内健身比赛的视频在网上疯传，一些人对卫生问题表示担忧，另一些人则对她坚持到底的决心表示敬意。一些人还批评比赛组织者让她继续比赛。 Hyrox 表示，他们在周六的活动结束后发起了“重大清理行动”，包括对设备进行消毒和更换部分地毯。 这家德国健身公司承认存在“合理的担忧”，但敦促人们不要将不满情绪归咎于这位运动员本人。 该公司没有透露该女子的身份，但网上透露了该女子的身份，她随后收到了暴力威胁。 Hyrox 在周一早些时候的一份声明中表示：“我们的社区不允许暴力威胁或鼓励伤害运动员。” “任何被认定参与这种行为的人——无论是通过评论、私信还是社交媒体——都将被永久禁止参加所有 Hyrox 活动，”声明称。 据中国媒体报道，同一活动的一些参与者要求道歉和退款，理由是他们被迫接触受污染的设备。 在每场 Hyrox 比赛中，参赛者交替进行一公里跑步和健身练习，例如推雪橇、立卧撑跳、室内划船和背着沙袋的箭步蹲。 该比赛自 2017 年在德国汉堡创办以来，人气爆棚，现已在世界各地举办。这项运动于 2024 年底在中国大陆首次亮相。 一些人质疑为什么上周末北京比赛的裁判员在运动员弄脏自己时没有进行干预，因为 Hyrox 会处罚包括随地吐痰和乱扔垃圾等行为。 “从基本健康和卫生的角度来看，这名运动员应该立即被阻止，任何受污染的区域都应该被关闭并适当清洁，然后才能允许其他运动员通过，”美国护士埃里卡·道奇在 Instagram 上的评论中写道。 周末也参加了 Hyrox 北京比赛的 Joe Ho 批评了 Hyrox 对这一问题的回应，并呼吁该组织“在自己的程序失败时承担责任”。 “如果组织承认出了问题，为什么不向受影响的参与者提供退款、积分或某种有意义的补偿形式呢？”他写道。 健身界的其他人指出，这对于耐力运动员来说并非闻所未闻。 Facebook 上的一条评论的作者指出，马拉松运动员也有类似的经历，而另一条评论则写道：“他们训练的时间太长、太……

reflection.en: In the aftermath of the Hyrox race, opinions are divided regarding the athlete's actions. This situation calls to mind the wisdom of Proverbs 18:17, which states that the first to speak in a dispute may seem right, until the other side is heard. It reminds us to consider all perspectives before forming a judgment.
reflection.zh: 在Hyrox比赛的余波中，人们对这位运动员的行为意见不一。这种情况让人想起箴言18:17的智慧，其中指出，在争论中先开口的似乎有理，直到另一方被听到。这提醒我们在形成判断之前，要考虑所有观点。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Israeli minister calls for Oscar-winning film directors to be stripped of citizenship
title.zh: 以色列部长呼吁取消奥斯卡获奖电影导演的公民身份

summary.en: An Israeli minister has called for the citizenship of the directors of an Israeli-made documentary about Gaza to be revoked, accusing them of "treason against the state." The film, "NAZA," features interviews with Israeli military and intelligence whistleblowers detailing AI-powered targeting systems used in Gaza. The...
summary.zh: 一位以色列部长呼吁取消一部以色列制作的关于加沙的纪录片导演的公民身份，指责他们犯有“叛国罪”。这部名为《NAZA》的电影采访了以色列军方和情报部门的举报人，详细介绍了在加沙使用的由人工智能驱动的瞄准系统。该纪录片在威尼斯电影节上获得了特别评审团奖。

body.en:
An Israeli minister has called for the award-winning directors of an Israeli-made Gaza documentary to be stripped of citizenship, accusing them of "treason against the state".

In the film NAZA, Israeli directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor spoke to 24 different Israeli military or intelligence whistleblowers who outlined the AI-powered targeting systems used to bombard Gaza that have killed tens of thousands of civilians.

The 80-minute documentary won a special jury prize at this year's Venice Film Festival over the weekend.

Israel's culture minister Miki Zohar accused the directors of being willing to "harm their homeland in order to receive applause from antisemites around the world".

"I will act immediately to revoke the Israeli citizenship of these despicable creators for treason against the state," he wrote on X.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Abraham and Szor won an Oscar in 2025 for their film No Other Land about Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank .

The documentary received a record 25-minute standing ovation at its premiere on Thursday — the second year in succession that a film about Gaza has resonated in Venice after The Voice of Hind Rajab, a true-life account of the killing of a Palestinian girl during the war.

"The Israeli intelligence officers we spoke with talked to us about how this mass killing is systemic, not by accident, but by ‌design, actions of murder and policies that are based on the total dehumanisation of Palestinians," Abraham said on Saturday.

In NAZA, 24 Israeli military insiders, including intelligence officers and soldiers, gave insight into the war in Gaza and what they say is the systemic killing of Palestinian civilians.

The film was shot in secret on rooftops in Tel Aviv over three years, and digital alterations obscure the subjects' identities by altering their voices and appearances.

The film's title references an Israeli military acronym used as a shorthand for civilian casualties, including men, women and children.

The subjects in the film detail the surveillance systems and remote bombing involved in the Israeli military's operation, which they say uses artificial intelligence to identify potential Hamas targets and bomb their homes and apartments, often knowing that families are inside.

"We just told these officers and soldiers, please describe to us what you did," Abraham said in a news conference on Thursday. "Of course there were other questions that arose but the principal question was a question of detail — 'sketch it for us, we want to know how it worked'. And sometimes just asking the question, you get answers."

body.zh: 以色列部长呼吁剥夺以色列制作的加沙纪录片的获奖导演的公民身份，指责他们“叛国”。 在电影《NAZA》中，以色列导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 与 24 名不同的以色列军方或情报举报人进行了交谈，他们概述了用于轰炸加沙的人工智能瞄准系统，该系统已造成数万名平民死亡。 这部 80 分钟的纪录片于上周末在今年的威尼斯电影节上获得了评审团特别奖。 以色列文化部长米基·佐哈尔指责导演们愿意“伤害自己的祖国，以获得世界各地反犹太主义者的掌声”。 他在 X 上写道：“我将立即采取行动，以叛国罪为由，撤销这些卑鄙创作者的以色列公民身份。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 亚伯拉罕和索尔凭借影片《无他之地》获得了 2025 年奥斯卡奖，该片讲述了以色列定居者在被占领的约旦河西岸的暴力行为。 这部纪录片在周四首映时获得了创纪录的 25 分钟起立鼓掌，这是继真实描述一名巴勒斯坦女孩在战争期间被杀的《印度之声》之后，有关加沙的电影连续第二年在威尼斯引起共鸣。 亚伯拉罕周六表示：“与我们交谈的以色列情报官员告诉我们，这种大规模杀戮是系统性的，不是偶然的，而是精心设计的、谋杀行为和基于对巴勒斯坦人完全非人化的政策。” 在 NAZA，24 名以色列军事内部人士，包括情报官员和士兵，深入了解了加沙战争以及他们所说的对巴勒斯坦平民的系统性杀害。 这部电影在特拉维夫的屋顶上秘密拍摄了三年，数字修改通过改变声音和外表来掩盖拍摄对象的身份。 影片的标题引用了以色列军方的缩写词，用作平民伤亡的速记，其中包括男性、女性和儿童。 影片中的主题详细介绍了以色列军方行动中涉及的监视系统和远程轰炸，他们说，这些行动使用人工智能来识别潜在的哈马斯目标，并轰炸他们的房屋和公寓，通常知道家人就在里面。 亚伯拉罕在周四的新闻发布会上说：“我们只是告诉这些官兵，请向我们描述一下你们做了什么。” “当然，还出现了其他问题，但主要问题是细节问题——‘为我们画出草图，我们想知道它是如何工作的’。有时只需提出问题，你就会得到答案。” NAZA 建立在...之间的报告之上

reflection.en: When state authorities demand silence or loyalty that conflicts with truth or conscience, the question of ultimate allegiance arises. The directors of "NAZA" faced intense pressure for presenting a critical perspective on military actions. The principle of obeying God over human rulers, even at personal cost, guides those who feel compelled to speak truth...
reflection.zh: 当国家当局要求沉默或要求与真相或良心相悖的忠诚时，就会出现最终效忠的问题。《NAZA》的导演们因提出对军事行动的批评性观点而面临巨大压力。即使要付出个人代价，也要服从上帝而非人类统治者的原则，指导着那些感到有义务向当权者说出真相的人。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
title.zh: 俄乌边境一列车遭袭，此前约翰逊等官员刚乘火车离开

summary.en: A Russian drone struck a train engine near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and other European security officials had passed through on a different train. No casualties were reported as passengers had been evacuated. Russia stated it targeted "railway infrastructure,"...
summary.zh: 一架俄罗斯无人机在英国前首相鲍里斯·约翰逊及其他欧洲安全官员乘坐的火车离开后不久，袭击了乌克兰-波兰边境附近的一列火车引擎。由于乘客已疏散，未报告伤亡。俄罗斯称袭击了“铁路基础设施”，而乌克兰则表示无人机可能瞄准了离开的官员。

body.en:
A Russian drone has hit a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and top European security officials had passed through.

No casualties were reported after the strike at Yahodyn, which hit the train's engine. All the passengers had been evacuated, Ukrainian authorities said.

Johnson and other European national security advisers, including the UK's Jonathan Powell, had passed along the same line on a different train on their way back from a conference in Kyiv.

Russia said it had struck "railway infrastructure" in western Ukraine, but Ukraine's state railway company Ukrzaliznytsia said that "quite possibly, the target of this drone could have been the diplomatic train".

Former CIA chief David Petraeus, who had been on board another train at Yahodyn station at the time of the strike, said the incident was "terrifying".

In an interview with the New York Times, Petraeus said: "This is the act of a truly barbaric leader trying to terrorize Ukrainian civilians."

In a statement, Ukrzaliznytsia said the diplomatic train "had left the station earlier than expected because of the timetable change... due to constant threats of Russian strikes".

It also said an evacuation order for passengers on the hit train had been given "just 15 minutes" before the strike by a Russian jet-propelled drone.

Both Ukrainian and Polish authorities said the Russian drone had struck 2km (1.2 miles) from the Polish border.

Former Swedish Prime Minister Carl Bildt, who had also attended the conference in Kyiv, told the BBC passengers on board his train had been told to prepare for evacuation before subsequently being allowed to continue their journey.

"On the train I was on we received order to prepare evacuation after it had stopped. But after a number of minutes we were informed that it was clear and we could proceed," he said.

Some reports have suggested Bildt was on the same train as Johnson, but the former UK prime minister has not confirmed any details.

Johnson wrote on X: "I don't know what warped logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian locomotive on the Polish border this morning.

He said this was "the kind of random and senseless attack Ukrainians are enduring every day - even on civilian railways" and urged Kyiv's allies to urgently provide Ukrainians "the air defences they need".

Ukraine has made repeated pleas to its allies - particularly the US - to provide more interceptors to defend against daily Russian attacks that increasingly use fast-moving ballistic missiles and jet-propelled drones.

Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said the "barbaric strikes" at the Ukraine-Poland border in Yahodyn amounted to "[Russian President Vladimir] Putin's terror 'knocking' directly on the doors of the...
body.zh: 在英国前首相鲍里斯·约翰逊和欧洲高级安全官员经过乌克兰-波兰边境后不久，一架俄罗斯无人机撞上了乌克兰-波兰边境附近的一列火车。 雅霍丁的袭击击中了火车的引擎，但没有造成人员伤亡的报道。乌克兰当局表示，所有乘客已被疏散。 约翰逊和其他欧洲国家安全顾问，包括英国的乔纳森·鲍威尔，在从基辅参加会议返回途中乘坐另一列火车沿着同一条线路经过。 俄罗斯称其袭击了乌克兰西部的“铁路基础设施”，但乌克兰国家铁路公司Ukrzaliznytsia表示，“这架无人机的目标很可能是外交列车”。 它在一份声明中表示，这列火车“由于时刻表的变化……由于俄罗斯持续的罢工威胁，比预期更早离开了车站”。 它还表示，在袭击发生前“仅15分钟”，一架俄罗斯喷气式无人机就向被撞列车上的乘客下达了疏散命令。 铁路部门还表示，无人机袭击发生时，前中央情报局局长戴维·彼得雷乌斯正在雅霍丁车站的另一列火车上。 乌克兰和波兰当局均表示，俄罗斯无人机袭击了距离波兰边境2公里的地方。 瑞典前首相卡尔·比尔特也参加了在基辅举行的会议，他告诉英国广播公司，他的火车上的乘客已被告知准备撤离，然后才被允许继续他们的旅程。 “在我乘坐的火车上，我们接到命令，在火车停下后准备撤离。但几分钟后，我们被告知情况已经清楚，我们可以继续前进，”他说。 一些报道称比尔特与约翰逊乘坐同一列火车，但这位英国前首相尚未证实任何细节。 约翰逊在X上写道：“我不知道是什么扭曲的逻辑促使普京今天早上炸毁了波兰边境上一辆静止的乌克兰机车。 他说，这是“乌克兰人每天都在遭受的那种随机和毫无意义的袭击——即使是在民用铁路上”。 约翰逊还表示，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京“对乌克兰1700名工作人员的死亡负有责任”，并敦促基辅的盟友紧急向乌克兰提供“他们需要的防空系统”。 乌克兰一再请求其盟友——特别是美国——提供更多拦截器，以防御俄罗斯越来越多地使用快速弹道导弹和喷气式无人机的日常攻击。 乌克兰外交部长安德里·西比哈表示，雅霍丁乌克兰-波兰边境的“野蛮袭击”相当于“普京的恐怖直接‘敲击’了欧盟和北约的大门”，并再次呼吁对莫斯科实施更多制裁。 “普京需要...

reflection.en: The attack on the train, occurring just after important figures had passed, evokes the grim logic of conflict where every action seems to invite a counter-action. The temptation to respond with escalating force is ever-present in such cycles. Yet, the call remains to overcome evil not by mirroring it, but by choosing a different path, even when it seems...
reflection.zh: 袭击火车，发生在重要人物刚刚经过之后，这让人联想到冲突中严峻的报复逻辑，似乎每一个行动都会招致反击。在这样的循环中，以升级武力回应的诱惑无处不在。然而，呼召依然是不要以恶报恶，而是选择另一条道路，即使这条道路看起来不可能。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Fears for two thirds of nation as displacement crisis grows in new front of Middle East war
title.zh: 也门冲突升级，人道危机加剧，或威胁全球航运路线

summary.en: Escalating conflict in Yemen has led to hundreds killed and tens of thousands displaced as Houthi forces advanced on key cities, seizing the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a vital global shipping route. The Houthis also claimed drone and missile attacks on Saudi Arabia.
summary.zh: 也门冲突升级，导致数百人死亡，数万人流离失所，胡塞武装部队向主要城市推进，并占领了重要的全球航运通道曼德海峡。胡塞武装还声称对沙特阿拉伯发动了无人机和导弹袭击。

body.en:
Hundreds have been killed and tens of thousands displaced as rebel Houthi forces in Yemen advanced on key cities in country over the weekend.

In advances following a week-long offensive that left hundreds dead, the Houthis seized the Yemeni side of the Bab al-Mandab Strait , one of the world's most important shipping arteries and the southern gateway to the Red Sea and the Suez Canal, threatening Saudi oil exports diverted from the Strait of Hormuz.

On Sunday, the Houthis — also known as Ansar Allah (supporters of God) — claimed to have used drones and missiles to target Saudi Arabia, including a military base just over the border with Yemen.

Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree didn't provide evidence or say when the attack occurred, according to the Associated Press.

Global charity Oxfam said escalations in Yemen pose a "dire threat" to an already struggling population after over a decade of civil war.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"The humanitarian impact is already severe," Yemen country director Ferran Puig said.

"Two thirds of the population in Yemen needs humanitarian assistance, and thousands are facing famine. Further military escalations will deepen hunger and displacement and disrupt the humanitarian assistance millions depend on to survive."

The Houthis are targeting Saudi oil infrastructure and shipping as part of a recently declared blockade, but they have said that other countries' shipping will not be targeted.

They now control the country's entire Red Sea coastline after capturing the key port city of Mocha in Taiz province from Yemeni government forces on Friday.

Government forces still control parts of Taiz province, including its capital city of the same name, but fighting in the area continues.

Military sources said that government forces had again attacked Houthi positions in the Taiz area.

More than 500 Yemeni troops have been killed during clashes with the Houthis between 9 August and 10 September, the government-aligned National Resistance Forces said in reports carried by local media in Yemen. The National Resistance Forces claimed that Houthi losses during the same period were far higher.

More than 950 violations against civilians have been documented across the western coast front lines following the Houthis’ entry into these cities, including more than 150 cases of killings, the Yemeni Network for Rights and Freedoms reported.

Residents have fled en masse towards Aden and the Lahj Governorate following the Houthis' takeover of the cities of Mocha and Khokha, as well as al-Wazi’iyah.

title.en: Swedish election in dead heat as anti-immigration far right loses ground
title.zh: 瑞典大选势均力敌，疑欧派和反移民的极右翼势力受挫

summary.en: Sweden's general election is virtually tied between the right-wing ruling party bloc and the centre-left opposition, with the far-right Sweden Democrats losing ground compared to previous elections.
summary.zh: 瑞典大选结果显示，执政的右翼政党集团与中左翼反对派几乎势均力敌，而极右翼的瑞典民主党则较以往选举失利。

body.en:
Sweden's leftwing opposition bloc held a razor-thin lead in Sunday's general election with half of the votes counted, with the far right seen losing ground.

With more than 50 per cent of votes counted, four opposition parties led by Social Democratic leader Magdalena Andersson, had a narrow lead with 49.3 per cent against 49.1 per cent for Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson's right-wing alliance, which includes the anti-immigration Sweden Democrats.

In a big surprise, the anti-immigration Sweden Democrats lost support for the first time since it entered parliament in 2010, with 17.7 per cent of the vote, down from 20.5 per cent in 2022.

"Of course it's a bit of a disappointment that we are not the second-biggest party anymore in these polls. But it's still not finished, it can still change," Julia Kronlid, a Sweden Democrat member of parliament, told Agence France-Presse (AFP) just after exit polls had showed the party retreating.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In the event of a left-wing victory, the four parties would face tough negotiations to form a government as they are splintered ideologically.

"I am confident that Magdalena is a skilled negotiator, and that she has a plan to make it work ... It might take a bit of time, but we will get a government led by Magdalena," Emilia Wikstrom Melin, a 40-year-old union analyst, told AFP at the Social Democrats' watch party.

Kristersson has headed a minority coalition backed by the Sweden Democrats for four years, giving the far-right influence over policy in exchange for support in parliament.

Kristersson promised the Sweden Democrats key cabinet posts if the right wing wins.

"It would be really tough for the country to go back to four years of the Social Democrats in power," Sweden Democrat supporter Bjorn Englen told AFP.

Throughout the campaign, opinion polls gave a comfortable lead to the left-wing opposition, but the gap narrowed to a dead heat in the final days.

Much of the campaign focused on healthcare and helping struggling households cope with rising costs.

Andersson, the first woman to head Sweden's government in 2021-22, is a staunch defender of Sweden's famed welfare state.

Her party ruled the Scandinavian country for most of the 20th century and remains Sweden's largest, though early results showed the party heading for its worst result in modern history.

Andersson has pledged to raise taxes on banks and high incomes, cut healthcare queues, and improve declining school results.

"We've had four years of rising unemployment, with a salary that pays for less and less," she said in a televised debate before the vote.

summary.en: Canceled language exams, disrupted plans to study in Germany, and the loss of an important cultural link: DW users shared how the closure of Germany's Goethe-Institut in Russia is impacting their lives. The Russian Foreign Ministry ordered the closure of the German cultural centers in Moscow, St. Petersburg, and...
summary.zh: 考试取消，留学德国的计划被打乱，重要的文化联系消失：德国之声的用户分享了德国歌德学院在俄罗斯关闭对其生活的影响。俄罗斯外交部下令关闭位于莫斯科、圣彼得堡和新西伯利亚的德国文化中心，以回应柏林方面对8月初发生在莱比锡机场的无人机袭击事件的反应，德国当局指责莫斯科策划了此次袭击。

body.en:
Canceled language exams, disrupted plans to study in Germany and the disappearance of an important cultural link: DW users shared how the closure of Germany's Goethe-Institut in Russia has affected their lives.

Germany's Goethe-Institut is set to close all Russian branches by Sunday, amid one of the worst spats in the history of relations between Russia and Germany .

The Russian Foreign Ministry ordered the closure of the German cultural centers in Moscow , St. Petersburg and Novosibirsk in response to Berlin's reaction to the attempted  drone attack  at Leipzig airport in early August.

In early September, German authorities blamed Moscow for organizing the attack and announced sanctions, which included closing the Russian culture and education center in Berlin, known as the Russian House , and the Russian Consulate General in Bonn, as well tightening visa restrictions for Russian citizens.

"All employees must cease their work in Russia as of September 13, 2026," Goethe-Institut Secretary General Gitte Zschoch said in a statement on Tuesday. "No more books can be borrowed from our libraries, and no further training can be offered. German language teachers are losing an important source of professional training and support. For people in Russia, this further restricts access to the German language, culture and reliable information from and about Germany."

DW asked its users in Russia to share how the closure of the Goethe-Institut will affect them personally. The responses received do not constitute a representative survey. All users shared their stories on conditions of anonymity. Russian authorities have labeled DW an "undesirable organization," making every cooperation with the media company a criminal offense.

Many DW readers fear that, after the closure of the Goethe-Institut branches, they or their relatives will no longer be able to take exams in Russia for internationally recognized German language certificates. 

Some readers pointed out that closing the Goethe-Institut in Russia will hit ethnic Germans willing to relocate back to Germany, or late repatriates, especially hard.

"I no longer live in Russia, having emigrated as a late repatriate, but my parents are still in Russia and were planning to take exams at the Goethe-Institut this fall or winter before submitting their resettlement documents. It looks like they'll have to take the exams in another country, which means additional stress and expenses for them," one reader said.

DW also received responses from parents whose children are learning German and plan to continue their education in Germany.

"My son attends a German school, and now we won't be able to take the exam in Russia. We'll have to travel to another country," one message said.

It remains unclear...

title.en: A Romani artist in Hungary reclaims his identity
title.zh: 匈牙利罗姆族艺术家重塑身份

summary.en: Norbert Olah, a Romani artist in Hungary, initially shied away from incorporating his ethnic background into his work due to fears of being stereotyped. However, he eventually shifted his focus, making his Romani identity central to his art.
summary.zh: 匈牙利罗姆族艺术家诺伯特·奥拉赫（Norbert Olah）曾因担心被贴标签而回避在艺术中融入自己的民族背景。然而，他最终将焦点转向了这一点，使他的罗姆族身份成为其艺术创作的核心。

body.en:
Norbert Olah is an artist. He's also Romani. For a long time, he avoided making his ethnic background a theme of his art for fear of being pigeonholed. Then it became his focus.

The painting on the canvas is of a man playing chess with a robot; the color on the man's face is still damp and glistening. Norbert Olah was working into the early hours at the Bura Galeria in Budapest , his studio for the summer. He finds it easiest to concentrate at night, when the Hungarian capital gradually falls silent.

Olah has taped foil and cardboard over the tiled floor at the back of the gallery. Pots of brushes, tubes of paint, pencil sketches, and, over and over again, pictures that include the blue-and-green Roma flag line the room.

Olah is an artist. He's also Romani. For a long time, he deliberately left this part of his identity out of his art. Not because his ethnicity wasn't important to him, but because he didn't want to be labeled a "Romani artist."

"There are so many prejudices about Roma culture and Roma art," said Olah. "The art scene regards it as naive, unprofessional, unsophisticated and kitsch."

But the older Olah got, the harder he found it to ignore his own story in his art. Especially in a country in which being Romani is not just an ethnicity but a political reality.

The first time Viktor Orban 's Fidesz party won an absolute majority in the Hungarian parliamentary election in 2010, Olah had just finished school and was starting his art course at the Hungarian University of Fine Arts in Budapest. At a time of life when the world ought to be opening up, Olah felt that more and more barriers were being erected.

Olah was directly affected by Hungary 's political reorientation, as both an artist and a Romani. Politics co-opted the cultural scene and made it toe the party line. Roma became the target of hateful rhetoric, including from the prime minister himself. Orban repeatedly called attention to himself with racist comments about Roma.

For the 16 years Orban was in power, Hungary's Roma population, estimated to be around 700,000 people, was caught between official promises of integration and persistent marginalization. Orban's government introduced a state employment program that hired predominantly Romani workers. But instead of helping them gain a foothold in the job market, many Romani found themselves trapped in insecure, poorly paid temporary jobs. The government did little to implement real change. Romani in Hungary are still disproportionately affected by poverty and social exclusion.

body.zh: 诺伯特·奥拉 是一位艺术家。他也是罗马人。很长一段时间，他避免将自己的种族背景作为他的艺术主题，以免被归类。然后就成了他关注的焦点。 画布上的画是一个人与机器人下棋。他脸上的颜色仍然湿漉漉的，闪闪发亮。 Norbert Olah 一直工作到凌晨：布达佩斯的 Bura Galeria 整个夏天都是他的工作室。他发现晚上最容易集中注意力，此时匈牙利首都逐渐陷入寂静。 奥拉在画廊后面的瓷砖地板上贴了箔纸和纸板。房间里摆满了画笔盆、颜料管、铅笔草图，以及一遍又一遍的图片，其中包括蓝绿相间的罗马国旗。 诺伯特·奥拉 是一位艺术家。他也是罗马人。很长一段时间，他刻意将自己的这部分身份从他的艺术中剔除。并不是因为他的种族对他来说不重要，而是因为他不想被贴上“罗马艺术家”的标签。 “对于罗姆文化和罗姆艺术存在很多偏见，”奥拉说。 “艺术界认为它是幼稚的、不专业的、不成熟的、庸俗的。” 但奥拉年龄越大，他就越难忽视自己在艺术中的故事。尤其是在一个罗姆人不仅是一个种族而且是一个政治现实的国家。 2010 年，欧尔班·维克多 (Viktor Orban) 领导的青民盟 (Fidesz) 政党首次在匈牙利议会选举中赢得绝对多数，当时奥拉刚刚完成学业，正在布达佩斯的匈牙利美术大学开始他的艺术课程。在世界应该开放的人生阶段，奥拉感到越来越多的障碍正在建立。 作为一名艺术家和罗姆人，奥拉直接受到匈牙利政治重新定位的影响。政治吸纳了文化界并使其遵守党派路线。罗姆人成为仇恨言论的目标，其中包括总理本人。欧尔班多次用针对罗马的种族主义言论引起人们的注意。 在欧尔班执政的 16 年里，匈牙利的罗姆人估计约有 70 万，他们陷入了官方承诺的融合和持续边缘化之间。欧尔班政府推出了一项国家就业计划，主要雇用罗姆人工人。但许多罗姆人并没有帮助他们在就业市场上站稳脚跟，而是发现自己陷入了不稳定、低薪的临时工作之中。政府几乎没有采取任何行动来实施真正的变革。匈牙利的罗姆人仍然不成比例地受到贫困和社会排斥的影响。 到了某个时刻，诺伯特·奥拉觉得他不能再袖手旁观。 2021年，在匈牙利最大的独立当代艺术活动——布达佩斯OFF双年展期间，奥拉和他的父亲砌了一堵砖墙……

reflection.en: Norbert Olah’s journey mirrors the deep human longing to belong and be seen authentically. His decision to reclaim and center his Romani identity in his art speaks to the power of embracing who we are, rather than hiding from it. This resonates with the biblical truth that in God's eyes, such divisions fade, and we are united as one. “There is neither Jew...
reflection.zh: 诺伯特·奥拉赫的经历呼应了人类渴望归属和真实被看见的深层愿望。他选择重塑并以其罗姆族身份为艺术创作的中心，体现了拥抱真实自我的力量，而非躲藏。这与圣经的真理产生共鸣：在雅伟眼中，这些区分都消退了，我们在基督耶稣里合而为一。 “并不分犹太人、希腊人，自主的、为奴的，或男或女，因为你们在基督耶稣里都成为一体了。” 加拉太书 3:28

verse.textEn: There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
verse.textZh: 并不分犹太人、希利尼人，自主的、为奴的，或男或女，因为你们在基督耶稣里都成为一了。

title.en: Trump visits Ireland, says unification would be 'fantastic'
title.zh: 特朗普访问爱尔兰，称统一将是“极好的”

summary.en: US President Donald Trump's trip to Ireland to watch a golf tournament has also included meetings with leaders there. During his visit, Trump expressed his desire to see the Republic of Ireland unite with British-run Northern Ireland.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普前往爱尔兰观看高尔夫比赛的行程中，还包括与当地领导人的会晤。在访问期间，特朗普表达了他希望看到爱尔兰共和国与英国统治下的北爱尔兰统一的愿望。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump's trip to Ireland to watch a golf tournament has also included meetings with leaders there.

US President Donald Trump has said he would "love" to see the Republic of Ireland , an EU member, unite with British-run ⁠Northern Ireland as he faced reporters' questions on a range of issues on Saturday.

Trump is taking the weekend trip largely to watch the Irish Open golf tournament held on a course he owns on the country’s Atlantic coast, but he met as well with the Irish president and prime minister, or taoiseach.

The US leader also spoke optimistically about his country's war with Iran and its trade conflict with Canada , among several other topics.

After a meeting with Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin in the capital, Dublin, Trump said he very much supported what he said would be the eventual unification of the two parts of the island of Ireland.

"Well, I don't want to ​cause any problems, ​but ‌I will tell you, I'd love to see ‌it unified," Trump told ‌reporters.

"The way I look at it, it's ⁠going ​to happen ​eventually ... I think it would ​be a ‌fantastic thing," he added.

"Now the UK will have ​something ⁠to say about it ... but ⁠I think ​it would be a great thing."

The British government responded swiftly to the remarks, with Prime Minister Andy Burham's office saying that in his view, there was no majority public support for a referendum on the issue and that there would not be another one until that changed. 

Previous US presidents have avoided touching on the subject in view of the delicate nature of the issue, with Northern Ireland seeing decades of of deadly sectarian violence in the 20th century over the question of whom it should belong to.

Trump also said that the US war with Iran, which began on February 28, would "end very soon" — a view he has frequently expressed in the past, but which has not yet materialized.

He also said that the end of the conflict would mean that the price of oil, which has soared as a result of the war, would "come tumbling down."

However, he vehemently defended his decision to mount the military operation against Iran.

He said that the US attacked because "Iran cannot have a nuclear weapon", adding: "They were two weeks away from having a nuclear weapon."

"If they had it, they would have blown up Israel, they would have blown up the Middle East, and they would have hit some [...] in my opinion, [of] Europe's cities and beyond cities, and they would probably hit us soon before we put out the fire. But they cannot have a nuclear weapon."

The war with Iran is not supported by a majority of the US population, particularly in view of promises made by Trump on the campaign trail to keep his country out of foreign...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普前往爱尔兰观看高尔夫锦标赛的行程还包括与当地领导人的会面。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在周六就一系列问题接受记者提问时表示，他“乐意”看到欧盟成员国爱尔兰共和国与英国管理的北爱尔兰团结起来。 特朗普周末旅行主要是为了观看在该国大西洋海岸他拥有的球场上举行的爱尔兰高尔夫公开赛，但他也会见了爱尔兰总统和总理（或称爱尔兰总理）。 这位美国领导人还乐观地谈到了美国与伊朗的战争以及与加拿大的贸易冲突等几个话题。 在首都都柏林与爱尔兰总理迈克尔·马丁会面后，特朗普表示，他非常支持他所说的爱尔兰岛两部分的最终统一。 “好吧，我不想造成任何问题，但我会告诉你，我很乐意看到它统一，”特朗普告诉记者。 “在我看来，这最终会发生……我认为这将是一件奇妙的事情，”他补充道。 “现在英国对此有话要说……但我认为这将是一件伟大的事情。” 英国政府迅速回应了这一言论，首相安迪·伯勒姆的办公室表示，在他看来，没有大多数公众支持就此问题举行公投，并且在情况改变之前不会再举行公投。 鉴于该问题的微妙性质，历任美国总统都避免触及这一主题，北爱尔兰在 20 世纪因归属问题而发生了数十年致命的宗派暴力。 特朗普还表示，2月28日开始的美国与伊朗的战争将“很快结束”——这是他过去经常表达的观点，但尚未实现。 他还表示，冲突的结束将意味着因战争而飙升的石油价格将“暴跌”。 然而，他强烈捍卫自己对伊朗采取军事行动的决定。 他说，美国发动袭击是因为“伊朗无法拥有核武器”，并补充道：“他们距离拥有核武器还有两周的时间。” “如果他们拥有的话，他们会炸毁以色列，他们会炸毁中东，他们会袭击一些……在我看来，欧洲的城市和其他城市，他们可能会在我们扑灭大火之前不久袭击我们。但他们不可能拥有核武器。” 与伊朗的战争并没有得到大多数美国民众的支持，特别是考虑到特朗普在竞选过程中做出的让他的国家远离外国的承诺……

reflection.en: During his visit to Ireland, President Trump voiced his support for the unification of the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland. This statement, made amidst a golf tournament, touches upon the long-standing political aspirations and complexities of the region. The pursuit of peace and reconciliation often involves navigating deeply rooted historical and...
reflection.zh: 在访问爱尔兰期间，特朗普总统表达了他对爱尔兰共和国与北爱尔兰统一的支持。这一声明是在高尔夫比赛期间发表的，触及了该地区长期存在的政治愿望和复杂性。追求和平与和解往往需要驾驭根深蒂固的历史和政治格局，这是一个需要所有相关方耐心和理解的过程。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。
