title.en: Trump downplays warnings of AI risks, citing rivalry with China
title.zh: 特朗普淡化人工智能风险警告，称与中国竞争是原因

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has downplayed concerns about the risks of artificial intelligence, suggesting that 'negative forces' were raising issues about 'things that won't happen.' This comes after days of dire warnings from experts, including a former AI researcher who stated there's a 'strong chance that we could...
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普淡化了对人工智能风险的担忧，暗示“负面势力”正在提出“不会发生的事情”的问题。此前，包括一位前人工智能研究员在内的专家们发出了严厉警告，该研究员表示，如果开发继续不受控制，“我们都有可能在不久的将来死亡”。顶尖行业领袖也呼吁放缓人工智能的发展。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump has downplayed risks posed by artificial intelligence following days of dire warnings by experts.

"You have a lot of very negative forces that are bringing it up that shouldn't be bringing it up and they're bringing up things that won't happen," Trump said during a visit to Ireland.

One of the warnings came from a former Anthropic researcher who said "there is a strong chance that we could all die in the immediate future" if the current pace of development continued.

On Saturday, top industry bosses agreed and called for a slow-down. Trump did not directly address the idea, but said: "We're leading China on AI... and, frankly, I want to keep it that way because whoever wins AI, wins."

Trump spoke on the same day AI researcher Jacob Coxon - who quit Anthropic a few days ago - told the BBC that staff who were developing the systems were "genuinely frightened" for the future of humanity.

Coxon – who has also worked at OpenAI – welcomed the idea of a slowdown but said it would need to be co-ordinated with China.

On Saturday, Elon Musk, owner of xAI, and Sam Altman of OpenAI, backed a warning from the head of Anthropic Dario Amodei that the pace of development should be slowed "to reduce the risk that something goes seriously wrong".

The Anthropic CEO said any slowdown would have to be limited to avoid allowing China to pull ahead.

The issues surrounding AI have prompted fierce debate - and present a dilemma for many world leaders.

On one hand, the sector is seen as a huge opportunity to boost economic growth and a way to improve outdated digital systems and ways of working.

But there have also been a number of incidents where AI appears to have gone seriously wrong.

In August, OpenAI said it had slowed down training some of its most advanced AI models to improve security.

The ChatGPT-maker said it was adding new measures after its AI agents bypassed safeguards and hacked the tech start-up Hugging Face .

And the same month it was disclosed two of the world's most powerful AI tools created fake human profiles to try and trick people in attempted cyber-attacks.

The UK's AI Security Institute (AISI) said in the most serious case, Anthropic's Mythos AI tried to gain access to a service by sending private messages, having set up fake accounts mimicking real people - then hid the evidence.

The Trump administration argues that the US must maintain global tech dominance as a matter of national security, though it has admitted a need for vigilance around the risks posed by the emerging technology.

The weekend call by major AI executives sparked discussion in Washington, where lawmakers are facing pressure to address those potential risks around rapid AI developments.

On Sunday, Speaker Mike Johnson, the top House...
body.zh: 在专家连续几天发出可怕警告后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普淡化了人工智能带来的风险。 特朗普在访问爱尔兰时表示：“有很多非常消极的力量在提出不应该提出的问题，他们提出了不会发生的事情。” 其中一个警告来自一位前人类研究人员，他表示，如果目前的发展速度继续下去，“我们很有可能在不久的将来都会死亡”。 周六，行业高层表示同意并呼吁放缓步伐。特朗普没有直接谈到这个想法，但表示：“我们在人工智能方面领先中国……坦率地说，我希望保持这种状态，因为谁赢得了人工智能，谁就获胜了。” 就在特朗普发表讲话的同一天，几天前退出 Anthropic 的人工智能研究员雅各布·考克森 (Jacob Coxon) 告诉 BBC，开发这些系统的员工对人类的未来“真正感到恐惧”。 曾在 OpenAI 工作过的考克森对经济放缓的想法表示欢迎，但表示这需要与中国协调。 周六，xAI 所有者埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和 OpenAI 的萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 支持 Anthropic 负责人达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 的警告，即应放慢开发速度，“以降低出现严重问题的风险”。 这位Anthropic首席执行官表示，任何放缓都必须受到限制，以避免让中国领先。 围绕人工智能的问题引发了激烈的争论，并给许多世界领导人带来了困境。 一方面，该行业被视为促进经济增长的巨大机遇，也是改进过时数字系统和工作方式的一种方式。 但也有一些人工智能似乎出现严重错误的事件。 8 月，OpenAI 表示已放慢了一些最先进人工智能模型的训练速度，以提高安全性。 ChatGPT 制造商表示，在其人工智能代理绕过安全措施并入侵科技初创公司 Hugging Face 后，该公司正在增加新的措施。 同月，世界上最强大的两个人工智能工具被披露创建了虚假的人类档案，试图欺骗人们进行网络攻击。 英国人工智能安全研究所 (AISI) 表示，在最严重的案例中，Anthropic 的 Mythos AI 试图通过发送私人消息来获取服务，并建立了模仿真人的虚假账户，然后隐藏了证据。 主要人工智能高管的周末电话会议在华盛顿引发了讨论，立法者面临着解决人工智能快速发展的潜在风险的压力。 周日，众议院共和党领袖、众议院议长迈克·约翰逊 (Mike Johnson) 在美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 的杰克·塔珀 (Jake Tapper) 国情咨文节目中露面时，敦促谨慎对待匆忙的人工智能监管，认为这可能“扼杀美国的创新”。 “如果国会尽快介入并且......

reflection.en: In matters of great consequence, leaders are called to heed the counsel of wise advisors. When President Trump dismisses dire warnings about artificial intelligence, citing national rivalry, he risks overlooking potential dangers that could affect all of humanity. True leadership involves discerning truth and acting with foresight, not just ambition.
reflection.zh: 在关乎重大的事务上，领导者被呼召要听取智者的建议。当特朗普总统以国家竞争为由，忽视关于人工智能的严峻警告时，他可能忽略了可能影响全人类的潜在危险。真正的领导力在于辨别真理并有远见地行动，而不仅仅是追求野心。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Xi Jinping gets red carpet at Brics summit amid thaw in India-China relations
title.zh: 习近平出席金砖峰会获红地毯礼遇，中印关系出现缓和

summary.en: Chinese President Xi Jinping received a formal welcome in India for the BRICS summit, marking a significant step toward reconciliation after the 2020 military conflict. While the two nations remain regional rivals, the public display of thawing relations suggests a mutual desire to stabilize the border and cooperate...
summary.zh: 中国国家主席习近平在印度出席金砖国家峰会时受到红地毯欢迎，这被视为中印在2020年发生致命军事冲突后迈向和解的重要一步。尽管两国仍是地区竞争对手，但这种公开的缓和迹象表明，双方都有意稳定边境并在全球舞台上进行合作。

body.en: Chinese president’s arrival in Delhi seen as step towards reconciliation after deadly 2020 military clash The Chinese president, Xi Jinping, has received a red-carpet welcome in India for a summit of Brics developing nations, as regional rivals Beijing and Delhi make a public display of thawing relations while quietly competing to lead at a time of shaky US global dominance. As Xi stepped off the plane, he was walked past an honour guard of Indian soldiers and traditional dancers in colourful dresses. Later on Saturday, he was due to attend a gala dinner for the two-day summit. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国国家主席抵达德里被视为2020年致命军事冲突后迈向和解的一步 中国国家主席习近平在印度出席金砖国家发展中国家峰会时受到红地毯欢迎，区域竞争对手北京和德里公开展示关系解冻，同时在美国全球主导地位摇摇欲坠之际悄悄竞争领导地位。当习近平走下飞机时，他走过由印度士兵和身着彩色服装的传统舞者组成的仪仗队。周六晚些时候，他将出席为期两天的峰会的晚宴。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The red-carpet welcome for President Xi in Delhi serves as a powerful symbol of reconciliation following the deadly 2020 military clash. It demonstrates that even between fierce regional rivals, the pursuit of stability is a necessary and honorable path. This diplomatic effort reflects the heart of Yahweh, who calls us to live at peace with all people as...
reflection.zh: 习近平主席在德里受到红地毯欢迎，是2020年致命军事冲突后和解的有力象征。这表明，即使在激烈的地区竞争对手之间，追求稳定也是一条必要且光荣的道路。这种外交努力反映了雅伟的心意，祂呼召我们要竭力与众人和睦相处，只要凡事能在乎自己。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: BRICS summit leaders urge 'maximum restraint' in Middle East
title.zh: 金砖国家领导人呼吁在中东“保持最大克制”

summary.en: The joint declaration at the BRICS 2026 summit expressed 'deep concern' over hostilities in the Middle East and called for 'maximum restraint.' China's President Xi Jinping stated that the Iran war was not in the bloc's interest.
summary.zh: 在2026年金砖国家峰会上发表的联合声明中，与会领导人对中东地区的敌对行动表示“深切关注”，并呼吁“保持最大克制”。中国国家主席习近平表示，伊朗战争不符合该集团的利益。

body.zh: 金砖国家2026年峰会联合声明表达了对中东敌对行动的“深切关注”。中国国家主席习近平表示，伊朗战争不符合欧盟利益。 该博客现已关闭。以下是 2026 年 9 月 12 日至 13 日在印度举行的 2026 年金砖国家峰会的一些头条新闻摘要： 厌倦了错过我们的实时更新？ 单击此处将我们添加为 Google 上的首选来源。然后点击“星标”或“首选”，将 DW News 保留在您的 Feed 顶部。 这份长达45页的声明中有一段是关于伊朗战争的。它对中东局势升级表示“深切关注”，并呼吁“最大限度克制”。 这就是金砖国家外交——也是这个多元化集团能够达成一致的唯一措辞。这场战争直接涉及三个金砖国家——伊朗、阿联酋和沙特阿拉伯——这三个国家处于冲突的对立面。 即使是这样的措辞也需要谨慎的外交和夜班才能完成。尽管如此，这可以说比什么都没有好——尤其是在所有三个国家都派代表参加会议的情况下，而且中国为金砖国家提供了调解作用。 这与去年里约金砖国家声明不同，金砖国家声明至少提到了成员国“对乌克兰冲突的国家立场”。 但即便如此，俄罗斯也没有被点名，其入侵也没有受到谴责，也没有要求俄罗斯军队撤军。 对于普京来说，现在的完全省略在政治上是有用的——特别是因为他在德里，而不是在里约。 习近平自 2019 年以来就没有访问印度。2020 年两国有争议的喜马拉雅边境发生致命冲突后，两国关系陷入僵局。 他在德里与莫迪的会晤标志着这两个亚洲核大国之间谨慎解冻的又一步，或许也向华盛顿发出了一个信号。 莫迪和习近平都希望世界更加多极化，减少西方在全球金融体系中的主导地位。但他们的立场却截然不同。 中国已经是世界第二大经济体，拥有强大而自信的军事力量。它的重点是对抗华盛顿。 与此同时，印度出于不同原因，正在追求多边结盟和战略自主，与俄罗斯、美国和欧盟建立关系，但没有加入中国阵营。 不信任依然存在，尤其是在有争议的边界以及谁能塑造亚洲方面。印度对中国的巨额贸易逆差又增加了一层。 唐纳德·特朗普是房间里的大象。但德里宣言中没有提到他和美国的名字。 尽管如此，它们仍然存在：金砖国家领导人谴责单边制裁并对单边关税表示担忧。 于是就有了共同的烦恼……

reflection.en: The BRICS summit declaration calls for 'maximum restraint' in the Middle East, a plea for de-escalation amidst conflict. This echoes the Beatitude, 'Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.' May leaders and nations heed this call, seeking paths of peace over further violence.
reflection.zh: 金砖国家峰会的联合声明呼吁在中东“保持最大克制”，这是在冲突中呼吁缓和局势。这呼应了“使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必得称为神的儿子”的教导。愿各国领导人和国家都能听从这一呼吁，寻求和平之道，而非进一步的暴力。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: India's BRICS strategy tested with Xi, Putin set to visit
title.zh: 印度金砖国家战略面临考验，习近平和普京即将访印

summary.en: India's 'America Plus' strategy involves strengthening ties with China and Russia while simultaneously attempting to prevent the BRICS bloc from becoming a platform against the West. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to host the BRICS summit in New Delhi, which will include Chinese President Xi Jinping's first visit...
summary.zh: 印度“美国加”战略涉及加强与中国和俄罗斯的联系，同时试图阻止金砖国家集团成为反西方平台。印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪将主办金砖国家峰会，中国国家主席习近平自2019年以来首次访印，而印度与华盛顿的关系仍面临挑战。

body.en:
New Delhi's "America Plus" approach sees India deepening its ties with China and Russia, while also trying to keep BRICS from turning into an anti-Western platform.

India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi will host the 18th BRICS summit this weekend in New Delhi, welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping to India for the first time since 2019.   

The summit comes at an important moment for India . As New Delhi's year-long BRICS presidency draws to a close, India is stepping up engagement with China and Russia , and its relationship with Washington remains difficult .

Modi met both Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, on August 31 and September 1. Just two weeks later, Modi is set to see them again in New Delhi for the BRICS summit.

But with BRICS both growing in size and increasingly troubled by internal divisions, the forum might limit Modi's diplomatic gains.

Indian diplomats are trying to protect their room for maneuver in a changing international order.

Ashok Kantha, a former Indian ambassador to China, said India's engagement with BRICS and the SCO is part of New Delhi's longstanding strategy of strategic autonomy.

"These groupings give India a seat at the table and allow it to pursue its own interests while maintaining relationships with different major powers," Kantha told DW.

However, as Modi prepares to host Xi in New Delhi, ties between India and China are less than ideal .

Both countries reached a border patrol agreement in 2024, ending a four-year military standoff along their disputed frontier.

International flights have resumed, the Kailash Mansarovar pilgrimage has reopened and some visa restrictions have eased. But major problems remain between Beijing and New Delhi — India is reporting a trade deficit of over $112 billion (€96.5 billion) with China, and the two countries argue over market access.

The Modi-Xi meeting will therefore be watched for signs of a major diplomatic thaw, particularly on trade and investment.

Kantha said the visit could bring some stabilization but should not be mistaken for a reset.

"The border remains heavily militarized and major differences over trade, investment and security remain. India needs a stable and predictable relationship with China, but without lowering its guard," said Kantha.

"It is a relationship of armed coexistence and managed competition. We should not reduce it to a simple 'elephant and dragon' story," he said, referring to traditional symbols of the world's two most populous nations.

India's presidency has already exposed the difficulty of reaching agreement within BRICS, which has grown from its original five members to 11.

With nations such as Brazil, South Africa, Indonesia and...
body.zh: 新德里的“美国+”方针让印度加深了与中国和俄罗斯的关系，同时也试图阻止金砖国家变成一个反西方的平台。 印度总理莫迪将于本周末在新德里主办金砖国家领导人第十八次峰会，欢迎中国国家主席习近平自 2019 年以来首次访问印度。 此次峰会对印度来说正值重要时刻。随着新德里为期一年的金砖国家轮值主席国任期接近尾声，印度正在加强与中国和俄罗斯的接触，其与华盛顿的关系仍然困难。 莫迪于8月31日和9月1日在吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会上会见了习近平和俄罗斯总统普京。仅仅两周后，莫迪将在新德里出席金砖国家峰会时再次会见他们。 但随着金砖国家规模不断扩大，内部分歧日益困扰，该论坛可能会限制莫迪的外交成果。 印度外交官正试图在不断变化的国际秩序中保护自己的回旋余地。 印度前驻华大使阿肖克·坎塔表示，印度与金砖国家和上合组织的接触是新德里长期战略自主战略的一部分。 坎塔对德国之声表示：“这些组织让印度在谈判桌上占有一席之地，并使其能够在与不同大国保持关系的同时追求自身利益。” 然而，当莫迪准备在新德里接待习近平时，印度和中国之间的关系并不理想。 两国于 2024 年达成边境巡逻协议，结束了两国争议边境长达四年的军事对峙。 国际航班已恢复，神山朝圣活动已重新开放，一些签证限制也已放宽。但北京和新德里之间仍存在重大问题——印度报告的对华贸易逆差超过1120亿美元（965亿欧元），两国在市场准入问题上存在争议。 因此，莫迪与习近平的会晤将受到重大外交解冻的迹象，特别是在贸易和投资方面。 坎塔表示，这次访问可能会带来一些稳定，但不应被误认为是重置。 坎塔表示：“边境仍然高度军事化，贸易、投资和安全方面的重大分歧依然存在。印度需要与中国建立稳定和可预测的关系，但又不能放松警惕。” “这是一种武装共存和有管理的竞争的关系。我们不应将其简化为一个简单的‘象与龙’故事，”他说，他指的是世界上人口最多的两个国家的传统象征。 印度担任轮值主席国已经暴露了金砖国家内部达成协议的难度，金砖国家成员已从最初的5个增加到11个。 与巴西、南非、印度尼西亚等国家...

reflection.en: In a world often defined by division, India's diplomatic approach seeks a delicate balance. The upcoming BRICS summit in New Delhi, with leaders from China and Russia attending, presents an opportunity for dialogue and the pursuit of peace, even amidst complex international relations. May wisdom guide these leaders as they navigate the path toward mutual...
reflection.zh: 在一个常常被分裂所定义的世界上，印度的外交方针寻求微妙的平衡。即将在新德里举行的金砖国家峰会，中国和俄罗斯的领导人将出席，这为对话和寻求和平提供了机会，即使在复杂国际关系中也是如此。愿智慧引导这些领导人，在寻求相互理解与合作的道路上。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

In August, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and heaping praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011. Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……

reflection.en: The news highlights how Kim Jong Un's regime continues to advance its nuclear ambitions, seemingly unfazed by diplomatic overtures. Proverbs 28:15 warns that 'When the wicked rule, people groan.' This verse speaks to the inherent instability and suffering that can arise when power is wielded without accountability, as seen in the continued acceleration of...
reflection.zh: 新闻指出，金正恩政权似乎并未受到外交示好的影响，仍在推进其核野心。箴言 28:15 警告说：“恶人在位，人就叹息。”这节经文呼应了当权力在缺乏问责的情况下被滥用时，可能产生的固有不稳定和苦难，正如在国际关注下朝鲜核计划的持续加速所见。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Putin arrives in India for Brics summit set to be dominated by Iran and Ukraine wars
title.zh: 普京抵达印度参加金砖国家峰会，伊朗和乌克兰战争或成焦点

summary.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin has arrived in Delhi for an 11-member BRICS summit, which is expected to be dominated by discussions on the wars in the Middle East and Ukraine, as well as economic challenges. Putin is scheduled to meet with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, and Chinese leader Xi Jinping is also...
summary.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京已抵达德里，参加有11个成员国的金砖国家峰会，会议预计将重点讨论中东和乌克兰战争以及经济挑战。普京计划与伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基扬举行会晤，中国领导人习近平也将出席为期两天的会议。

body.en: Russian president is due to meet his Iranian counterpart during visit, while Chinese leader Xi Jinping also set to attend summit Vladimir Putin has arrived in India’s capital of Delhi ahead of an 11-member Brics summit set to be dominated by wars in the Middle East and Ukraine, as well as economic challenges. The Russian president and his Iranian counterpart, Masoud Pezeshkian, were due to hold talks with India’s prime minister, Narendra Modi, while Chinese leader Xi Jinping was also expected to attend the two-day meeting. Continue reading...
body.zh: 俄罗斯总统将在访问期间会见伊朗总统，而中国领导人习近平也将出席峰会。 弗拉基米尔·普京 (Vladimir Putin) 已抵达印度首都德里，即将举行由 11 名成员组成的金砖国家峰会，峰会的主题将是中东和乌克兰的战争以及经济挑战。俄罗斯总统和伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安将与印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪举行会谈，而中国领导人习近平预计也将出席为期两天的会议。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As leaders gather for the BRICS summit, the shadow of ongoing conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East looms large. The gathering presents an opportunity for dialogue, a crucial step in the difficult pursuit of peace. May these leaders seek paths toward de-escalation and reconciliation, remembering that true strength lies in building bridges rather than...
reflection.zh: 随着各国领导人齐聚金砖国家峰会，乌克兰和中东地区持续的冲突阴影笼罩着会议。这次聚会提供了一个对话的机会，这是在艰难寻求和平过程中至关重要的一步。愿这些领导人寻求缓和局势与和解的道路，并铭记真正的力量在于搭建桥梁而非加深分歧。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: The Russia-tied French billionaires opening UK's first historical theme park – explainer

title.en: Call in China to end English's core status sparks debate
title.zh: 中国呼吁结束英语核心地位引发辩论

summary.en: A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers, and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.
summary.zh: 在中国学校降低英语地位的呼吁正在引发关于其对学生、职业以及人工智能时代中国全球竞争力的价值的讨论。

body.en:
A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent advocate for English as a required subject is Hu Xijin,...
body.zh: 降低中国学校英语等级的呼声引发了关于人工智能时代英语对学生、职业和中国全球竞争力价值的讨论。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。将英语作为必修科目的一位著名倡导者是胡锡进……

reflection.en: The debate in China about the role of English in education touches on how societies navigate the explosion of knowledge and global communication. As Professor Tang Jiafeng questions English's dominance, it mirrors the broader challenge of discerning which knowledge serves us best in an era of unprecedented information growth, as described in Daniel 12:4:...
reflection.zh: 在中国关于英语教育作用的辩论，触及了社会如何应对知识的爆炸式增长和全球交流。正如唐嘉风教授质疑英语的主导地位，这也反映了一个更广泛的挑战：在一个信息空前增长的时代，辨别哪些知识最能服务于我们。正如但以理书12:4所描述的：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。”

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

This reminds us of the call to 'act justly,' seeking to...

title.en: One Nation’s immigration policy deserves serious discussion – but not for the reason you might think | Alan Gamlen
title.zh: 一场关于移民政策的严肃讨论——但原因并非你所想

summary.en: One Nation's proposal to regulate the size and composition of the temporary migrant population has merit and warrants serious discussion, despite other aspects of the policy being blunt and punitive. The core idea of stabilizing the temporary population by controlling visa intake and permanent conversions is presented...
summary.zh: 一场关于移民政策的严肃讨论——但原因并非你所想。在一国党（One...

body.en:
The surprising thing about One Nation’s new immigration policy is not that it contains extreme ideas. It is that parts of it deserve serious discussion.

The best part is its pledge to regulate the size and composition of the temporary migrant population.

This is the right number to target because it links directly to problems people care about, including poor planning, obstacles to integration and migrant worker exploitation.

It is also feasible to contain. Its size is determined by two flows a government can control: the net intake of people on temporary visas, and the number who convert to permanent status.

If these flows are kept equal, the temporary population stabilises. This is not a theory or forecast. It is a mathematical fact.

By contrast, recent political debate has focused on net overseas migration (Nom): the difference between migrant arrivals and departures.

Nom provides a rough measure of all migration. So to claim Nom is the problem supports the false conclusion that all migration is problematic.

It is not. Some parts cannot and should not be regulated, such as movements of Australian citizens. Others, such as permanent migration, are already well regulated. Temporary migration, by contrast, was deregulated 25 years ago and now needs reviewing.

Regulating temporary migration means controlling how many temporary migrants arrive, how long they stay, how many leave and how many become permanent residents. This is all possible under existing legislation. What is changing is the political consensus about whether it is desirable.

Following Canada’s lead in regulating the temporary migrant population could help Australia avoid the problems of previous “guest worker” programs. One Nation deserves credit for putting this on the table.

Beyond this, however, its policy jumps from real problems to blunt, kneejerk cuts that would do more harm than good.

First, it proposes reducing the temporary migrant population by 750,000 over three years by pushing net overseas migration into negative territory.

Australia last recorded negative net overseas migration during the Covid border closure. Businesses failed, the economy contracted sharply and governments spent massively to cushion the shock. Deliberately recreating that outcome makes little sense.

Second, One Nation’s approach to departures is too punitive. Australia has the right to enforce its immigration laws, and people without a lawful basis to remain have to leave.

But a three-month deadline backed by aggressive enforcement and lifetime re-entry bans raises questions about proportionality and due process. Families, children, long residence and legal processes make cases more complicated than a blanket rule allows.

A migration system must be enforceable, fair and humane. The...
body.zh: 一国党新移民政策的令人惊讶之处并不在于它包含极端的想法。其中的某些部分值得认真讨论。 最好的部分是它承诺规范临时流动人口的规模和构成。 这是一个正确的目标数字，因为它与人们关心的问题直接相关，包括规划不善、融入障碍和剥削移民工人。 遏制也是可行的。其规模取决于政府可以控制的两个流向：持临时签证的净吸纳人数以及转换为永久身份的人数。 如果这些流量保持相等，临时人口就会稳定。这不是理论或预测。这是一个数学事实。 相比之下，最近的政治辩论主要集中在海外净移民（Nom）：移民到达和离开之间的差异。 Nom 提供了所有迁移的粗略衡量。因此，声称 Nom 就是问题支持了所有迁移都是有问题的错误结论。 它不是。有些部分不能也不应该受到监管，例如澳大利亚公民的行动。其他的，例如永久移民，已经受到很好的监管。相比之下，临时移民在 25 年前就放松了管制，现在需要重新审查。 规范临时移民意味着控制多少临时移民到达、停留时间、离开以及成为永久居民的数量。根据现行立法，这一切都是可能的。正在改变的是关于它是否可取的政治共识。 效仿加拿大在监管临时移民人口方面的领先地位，可以帮助澳大利亚避免之前“客工”计划的问题。一国党将这一问题摆上桌面值得赞扬。 然而，除此之外，其政策从真正的问题转向生硬、下意识的削减，这弊大于利。 首先，它建议在三年内将临时移民人口减少75万，将净海外移民推向负值。 澳大利亚上一次录得负净海外移民是在新冠疫情边境关闭期间。企业倒闭，经济急剧萎缩，政府投入巨资来缓解冲击。故意重现这种结果毫无意义。 其次，一国党对待离职的方式过于惩罚性。澳大利亚有权执行其移民法，没有合法居留依据的人必须离开。 但三个月的最后期限加上积极的执法和终身再入境禁令，引发了有关相称性和正当程序的问题。家庭、儿童、长期居住和法律程序使案件比一揽子规则所允许的更加复杂。 移民制度必须是可执行的、公平的和人道的。这...

reflection.en: In matters of national policy, especially those impacting human lives and communities, the pursuit of wisdom is paramount. The article highlights that even within a controversial proposal, there are elements that merit thoughtful consideration and discussion. This calls us to engage with complex issues, seeking the best counsel and discerning truth, rather...
reflection.zh: 在国家政策事务中，尤其是在那些影响人类生活和社区的政策上，追求智慧至关重要。文章指出，即使在一个有争议的提议中，也有值得认真考虑和讨论的方面。这呼吁我们深入探讨复杂的问题，寻求最佳的建议并辨别真理，而不是仅仅因为某个想法的来源而全盘否定它。

title.en: Labor appoints former Liberal leader Sussan Ley to Snowy Hydro board role
title.zh: 工党任命前自由党领袖苏珊·莱伊担任雪河水力公司董事会职务

summary.en: The Snowy Hydro 2.0 project is seven years behind schedule and $10 billion over budget.
summary.zh: 雪河水力2.0项目已延误七年，预算超支100亿澳元。

body.en:
A former coalition leader has been appointed by the Labor government to help steer the nation's most expensive and delayed renewable energy project.

Sussan Ley will sit on the Snowy Hydro board following her resignation from politics earlier this year, Climate Minister Chris Bowen announced on Monday.

The wholly government-owned project includes eight power stations and more than a dozen dams, spanning more than 100 kilometres from Thredbo to Tumut in NSW's south.

Snowy 2.0 is now being built and will store excess power from wind and solar, intended to become the centrepiece of the project.

Ley quit politics in February after being deposed by Angus Taylor as opposition leader, ending a 24-year career. She then took a reflective road trip around the United States, absorbing the sights of little-travelled areas on Greyhound buses.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Now, it is time for her to begin again — this time by tackling one of the country's most controversial projects.

Snowy 2.0, in the NSW Kosciuszko National Park, is seven years behind schedule. Costs have so far ballooned to $12 billion from an initial $2 billion budget and are expected to grow further.

It faced scrutiny for safety issues and hefty executive bonuses despite missing targets.

Ley's previous electorate of Farrer takes in the Murrumbidgee, Murray River and Albury, where many Snowy workers live.

She is being appointed alongside Merryn York, who has worked extensively on engineering technology.

"Their combined knowledge and skill will help Snowy Hydro deliver reliable power, stronger regional economies and more Australian jobs," Bowen said.

It is not the first time a Labor government has appointed a former Liberal politician to a government role. Previous NSW energy minister Matt Kean was named as the chair of the Climate Change Authority in 2024.

body.zh: 工党政府任命了一位前联盟领导人来帮助指导该国最昂贵且最拖延的可再生能源项目。 气候部长克里斯·鲍文 (Chris Bowen) 周一宣布，苏珊·雷 (Sussan Ley) 在今年早些时候辞去政坛职务后，将担任 Snowy Hydro 董事会成员。 这个政府全资拥有的项目包括八个发电站和十几座水坝，从新南威尔士州南部的斯雷德伯到蒂默特，全长 100 多公里。 Snowy 2.0 目前正在建设中，将储存来自风能和太阳能的多余电力，旨在成为该项目的核心。 莱伊在被安格斯·泰勒 (Angus Taylor) 废黜后，于 2 月退出政坛，结束了 24 年的政治生涯。然后，她在美国进行了一次反思性的公路旅行，乘坐灰狗巴士欣赏了人迹罕至的地区的景色。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 现在，她是时候重新开始了——这一次是解决该国最具争议的项目之一。 新南威尔士州科修斯科国家公园的 Snowy 2.0 比原计划晚了七年。迄今为止，成本已从最初的 20 亿美元预算激增至 120 亿美元，并且预计还会进一步增长。 尽管未达到目标，但它仍面临安全问题和巨额高管奖金的审查。 莱伊之前的法雷尔选区包括马兰比吉 (Murrumbidgee)、墨累河 (Murray River) 和奥尔伯里 (Albury)，那里是许多斯诺伊 (Snowy) 工人居住的地方。 她将与梅林·约克 (Merryn York) 一起被任命，梅林·约克在工程技术方面有着广泛的工作。 鲍文说：“他们的综合知识和技能将帮助 Snowy Hydro 提供可靠的电力、更强大的地区经济和更多的澳大利亚就业机会。” 这并不是工党政府第一次任命前自由党政治家担任政府职务。新南威尔士州前能源部长马特·基恩 (Matt Kean) 被任命为 2024 年气候变化管理局主席。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

It suggests a willingness to look beyond party lines for expertise to manage the nation's most expensive and delayed renewable energy project. This move, while perhaps surprising, could...

title.en: 'COVID-level shock': The professions fearing One Nation migration cuts

body.en:
One Nation's proposal to slash temporary migration has drawn criticism from the agricultural, business and education leaders, amid warnings the policy risks turning migration into a "political football" and could push Australia into recession.

On Monday, One Nation unveiled its plan to reduce Australia's temporary migrant population by 750,000 over three years by cutting student, graduate, temporary skilled, and bridging visas, as well as removing illegal migrants.

One Nation leader Pauline Hanson said the cuts were about "restoring control and making sure migration serves Australia".

But the proposal has drawn sharp criticism from several industries that heavily rely on temporary migration.

Michael Guerin, the chief executive of the National Farmers' Federation, said his organisation was yet to see the policy details but warned it could hurt regional Australia, noting worker shortages during the COVID-19 pandemic led to price rises of up to 25 per cent for produce.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Migration policy should not be treated as a political football. This is about food security, keeping farms operating and ensuring food remains affordable for Australian families," Guerin said in a statement.

"We haven’t seen the detail of this proposal, but we know temporary workers help put food on tables, with backpackers alone filling roughly one in seven farm jobs nationally.

"They also spend millions in regional communities and generally stay in hostels, caravan parks or purpose-built on-farm accommodation. They are not the cause of Australia's housing crisis."

He said any reform to migration settings needed consultation with the affected industries.

One Nation said the Working Holiday Maker program and the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility scheme — which allows businesses to hire from Pacific countries when there is a local worker shortage — would not be affected.

The federal government has already moved to slow backpacker arrivals , pausing applications from 24 of the 29 eligible countries last month amid a record number of working holidaymakers already in Australia.

Business groups have also raised concerns about One Nation's proposed cuts, with Business Council of Australia chief Bran Black warning they could have a "significant detrimental impact on our economic growth".

Citing Treasury forecasts, Black said the country's budget deficit — forecast at $31.5 billion in 2026-27 — was expected to increase in coming decades due to Australia's ageing population.

"As things stand right now, one in three occupations reports a skills shortage," he told ABC News.

title.en: Political leaders condemn Pauline Hanson over resurfaced remarks about Indigenous culture
title.zh: 政界人士谴责宝琳·汉森关于原住民文化的旧言论

summary.en: One Nation leader Pauline Hanson is facing renewed backlash for comments made in a podcast appearance a year ago, where she described Indigenous Australians as 'the most primitive race on earth'. Indigenous Australians Minister Malarndirri McCarthy condemned the remarks as 'completely racist' and divisive.
summary.zh: 一国党领袖宝琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）因一年前播出的播客节目中的言论而面临新的批评，她在节目中称澳大利亚原住民为“地球上最原始的种族”。原住民事务部长玛拉恩迪里·麦卡锡（Malarndirri McCarthy）谴责这些言论“完全是种族主义”，并具有分裂性。

body.en:
Pauline Hanson has been slammed as "completely racist" after she labelled Indigenous Australians "the most primitive race on earth".

The One Nation leader made the comments during an interview with the Jamie J podcast a year ago, where she criticised the study of Indigenous history in schools.

Hanson had "no respect whatsoever", Indigenous Australians Minister Malarndirri McCarthy said.

"It's totally outrageous, completely racist, but it also divides our country in a way that we do not want to see happen right here in Australia," she told reporters at Parliament House on Monday.

"I do believe that, as all Australians, we have to stand up and stand out against such divisive commentary ... that is not the Australia I know.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"It is not the Australia I want to see, and I call on all Australians to condemn such commentary."

Independent senator Lidia Thorpe urged Hanson to consider the "real harm" her commentary could cause.

"We know she won't change. She will continue to spread nasty, poorly informed and harmful ideas to rally her base and divide this country," she told the Australian Associated Press news agency.

Thorpe called on Prime Minister Anthony Albanese to "step up" and tackle racism.

"Pauline Hanson is running circles around them (Labor) spreading damaging and divisive ideas while this government sits on its hands," she said.

Hanson had already come under fire in the past week after a video she posted labelled Liberal MP and former special forces soldier Andrew Hastie a "traitor" and criticised Albanese's mother for living in public housing for several decades .

Labor cabinet minister Tanya Plibersek said on News24 there seemed to be no limit to who Hanson was willing to "kick down", and questioned the basis of her comments on Indigenous culture.

"If you don't take the time to learn about a culture, you've got no right to call it primitive."

body.zh: 波琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）将澳大利亚原住民称为“地球上最原始的种族”，之后她被猛烈抨击为“彻底的种族主义者”。 这位一国党领导人在一年前接受杰米·J播客采访时发表了上述言论，她批评了学校对原住民历史的研究。 澳大利亚原住民部长马拉迪里·麦卡锡 (Malarndirri McCarthy) 表示，汉森“毫无尊重”。 她周一在议会大厦对记者说：“这完全令人愤慨，完全是种族主义，但它也以我们不希望看到在澳大利亚发生的方式分裂我们的国家。” “我确实相信，作为所有澳大利亚人，我们必须站出来反对这种分裂性的评论……这不是我所认识的澳大利亚。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “这不是我想看到的澳大利亚，我呼吁所有澳大利亚人谴责这种评论。” 独立参议员莉迪亚·索普敦促汉森考虑她的评论可能造成的“真正伤害”。 “我们知道她不会改变。她将继续散布令人讨厌、消息不灵通和有害的想法，以团结她的支持者并分裂这个国家，”她告诉澳大利亚美联社。 索普呼吁总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞“挺身而出”解决种族主义问题。 “宝琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）在他们（工党）周围四处传播破坏性和分裂性的想法，而本届政府却袖手旁观，”她说。 汉森在过去一周已经受到了批评，此前她发布了一段视频，将自由党议员、前特种部队士兵安德鲁·哈斯蒂称为“叛徒”，并批评阿尔巴尼斯的母亲几十年来一直住在公共住房中。 工党内阁部长坦尼娅·普利伯塞克 (Tanya Plibersek) 在 News24 上表示，汉森愿意“踢倒”的人似乎没有限制，并质疑她对土著文化评论的基础。 “如果你不花时间去了解一种文化，你就没有权利称之为原始文化。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

title.en: Muslim schoolgirl called a 'terrorist' during racist tirade on Sydney bus
title.zh: 悉尼公交车上穆斯林女学生遭种族歧视辱骂“恐怖分子”

summary.en: Police are investigating an incident on a Sydney bus where a 13-year-old Muslim girl was subjected to racist abuse, including being called a 'terrorist.' The incident has been described as a 'microcosm of the state of Islamophobia' in Australia, with reports of Islamophobia increasing significantly.
summary.zh: 警方正在调查悉尼公交车上发生的一起事件，一名 13 岁的穆斯林女孩在车上遭受了种族歧视辱骂，包括被称作“恐怖分子”。此事件被描述为澳大利亚“伊斯兰恐惧症状况的一个缩影”，据报道，伊斯兰恐惧症的报告显著增加。

body.en:
A Muslim teenager was subjected to a stream of racist abuse on a Sydney bus after, according to her mother, she confronted a man she believed was photographing another schoolgirl.

NSW Police has confirmed it is investigating the incident that occurred when Janna, 13, was travelling towards Greenacre in Sydney's south-west on Thursday afternoon.

The incident is a "microcosm of the state of Islamophobia nationwide", according to the Islamophobia Register, which says it has recorded a more than sixfold increase in reports of Islamophobia since the October 7 attacks .

The teenager's mother, Roula, who was not on the bus at the time, said her daughter noticed an older man photographing another girl in school uniform and approached the girl to tell her.

"He heard my daughter and he started attacking her," Janna's mother Roula told SBS News.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Janna, in Year 8, told the man that what he was doing was "disgusting" — then the stream of abuse started.

Roula said he told her daughter, who was born in Australia, that she "didn't deserve to be in this country".

Footage of part of the incident has since circulated on social media, showing the man calling Janna a "terrorist", an "immigrant dog" and an "immigrant mutt", and telling her she "didn't deserve to be here".

She was also subject to a string of other slurs, including sexualised and dehumanising language, which SBS News has chosen not to publish.

In another video seen by SBS News — taken by someone else on the bus — a woman wearing a hijab is speaking to the man.

Roula said she was disappointed that no one else on the bus stepped in, including the driver or other adult male passengers.

"There was a lot of men sitting right next to that man and they were just looking up and looking back down at their phones," she said. "No one helped her, which is really, really, really disappointing."

She was also disappointed that the bus driver didn't intervene or eject the man from the bus.

"She's a minor. She was in full school uniform and the bus driver should have helped," Roula said.

It is understood the driver was unaware of the seriousness of the allegations when they were reported to him by another passenger.

"Everyone deserves the right to travel safely and feel safe on public transport," the spokesperson said.

Other schoolchildren on the bus can be heard in this footage addressing the man.

"You can hear them in the background screaming at him and calling him out to stop being racist, and none of the adults were actually saying anything," Roula said.

title.en: Man bitten by shark at Western Australian beach
title.zh: 西澳大利亚海滩发生鲨鱼袭击事件

summary.en: A man has been hospitalized with serious injuries following a shark attack at a remote beach in Western Australia. This incident follows two fatal shark attacks in the region in May and June.
summary.zh: 一名男子在西澳大利亚州一个偏远的海滩遭遇鲨鱼袭击后受重伤住院。此前，该地区在五月和六月已发生两起致命鲨鱼袭击事件。

body.en:
A man is in hospital with serious injuries following a shark attack at a remote beach.

Emergency services responded to Glenfield Beach, north of Geraldton in Western Australia's Midwest, shortly after 9.45am (11.45am AEST) on Monday.

A spokesperson confirmed the man was brought to the hospital with a shark bite and was in a serious but stable condition.

The state's Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development issued an alert, saying it had received a report of a possible shark incident and was investigating further.

title.en: Barnaby Joyce reveals more details on One Nation's plan to cut migration
title.zh: 澳洲一国党公布移民“重置”计划，拟削减75万临时移民

summary.en: One Nation has proposed a plan to significantly reduce migration, aiming for a 'net-negative' migration for three years. This policy, which would cut the temporary migrant population by 750,000, has faced strong criticism from the Labor and Coalition parties, who warn of severe economic consequences.
summary.zh: 澳洲一国党公布了一项计划，旨在大幅削减移民，并实现为期三年的“净负移民”。该政策将使临时移民人口减少75万，但遭到了工党和联盟党的强烈批评，他们警告称这将对经济产生严重影响。

body.en:
One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce said his party will cut Australia's migrant population "primarily by not issuing new" visas, after his party announced a plan to dramatically slash migration and bring it into "net-negative" for three years on Monday.

The policy would cut Australia's temporary migrant population by 750,000 over three years — a move One Nation says would ease pressure on housing and essential services and return the temporary migrant population to 2017 levels.

It includes cuts to student visas, graduate visas, temporary skilled visas and bridging visa holders, as well as the "departure and removal of illegal migrants".

In an interview with News24, Joyce said not allowing the family of temporary skilled workers to apply to join their partners or parents in Australia will cut down migration by more than 100,000 people.

"We bring up [the example of] nurses thinking, Oh well, that’s 50 per cent, or 30 per cent [of skilled migrants]. No, it’s 1 per cent or less, the nurses, and less than 1 per cent is aged care workers.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In 2025 the Australian Nursing and Midwifery Foundation reported internationally qualified nurses (IQNs) make up approximately 20 per cent of the total nursing workforce and in aged care this increases to 35 per cent.

Joyce also said universities are being used as a "backdoor" to migration, adding Australia is "going from a country to a caravan park".

"We're still having students come in. We're looking at a cap of 100,000 a year, but we're just not having this sort of universities used as basically a backdoor to migration into Australia," he said.

Following the "three-year reset", where more people would leave Australia than arrive, One Nation says its annual cap of 130,000 on net overseas migration (NOM) would remain in place and be reviewed each year.

Net overseas migration measures the difference between the number of people who arrive in Australia and those who depart, including returning Australians.

Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke delayed a National Press Club speech in August in which he was widely expected to announce migration cuts. It is understood the cabinet is still finalising plans.

Party leader Pauline Hanson said her plan was about "restoring control and making sure migration serves Australia".

The proposal expands on One Nation's existing migration policy after the party was forced to clarify its position in recent weeks following confusion sparked by comments from One Nation MP David Farley .

Members of both Labor and the Coalition criticised the plan in Monday morning media appearances.

title.en: Why Australia's richest suburbs could be a warning for every homeowner
title.zh: 为什么高层真空可能导致澳大利亚房地产市场下跌

summary.en: Experts warn that a downturn at the top of the market is beginning to spread to lower-priced real estate across Australia. Data shows that upper-quartile house prices in Sydney and Melbourne have fallen at more than double the rate of entry-level homes, with some high-end properties selling for millions less than...
summary.zh: 专家警告称，高端市场的低迷正开始蔓延到澳大利亚全国范围内的低价房地产。数据显示，悉尼和墨尔本的最高四分之一房价下跌速度是入门级住房的两倍多，一些高端房产的售价比峰值损失了数百万澳元。

body.en:
Across Australia's capital cities, prices in the upper end of the property market are dropping rapidly, with experts warning it could indicate where the rest of the sector is headed.

Recent data from property analytics firm Cotality reveals that upper-quartile house prices — those in the top 25 per cent — have fallen at more than double the rate of entry-level ones in Sydney and Melbourne.

High-end homes in both cities have seen declines of more than 10 per cent in value from their peak. By contrast, those in the lower quartile have seen declines of just 3.9 to 5.4 per cent.

In Sydney, a mansion in Balmain East sold for an extraordinary $7 million loss this month — after selling for almost $20 million in 2022, it was bought for $12.8 million.

Cotality executive research director Tim Lawless told SBS News that the top end of the housing market historically moves first in a property cycle. While the sector overall peaked in March, the upper end peaked in October/November last year .

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As the Reserve Bank's rate hikes filter through, Lawless said buyers are being hit with a severe credit crunch as borrowing rates hover around 9.5 per cent, severely weakening purchasing power.

A household on a median income is now spending more than 50 per cent of its pre-tax income to serve a median-priced mortgage. As a result, those who might have previously looked in the middle-to-upper bracket are being pushed toward cheaper stock.

"Mainstream demand is getting deflected towards lower price points where buyers can actually demonstrate an ability to service the loan," Lawless explained.

Taken together, first home buyers, investors, and price-sensitive mid-tier individuals are all now competing for limited stock, which has left high-end listings exposed.

The impact of the demand vacuum at the top has been visible on the ground for some time, with vendor discounting widening while time-on-the-market has lengthened.

Director and chief auctioneer at New South Wales independent AuctionWorks noted that the sharpest initial repricing has likely passed, however wealthy buyers are in no rush to step back in.

"The top end of the market has been the most affected, with significant price adjustments occurring in recent months," Davidson told SBS News.

"However, it appears that whilst we may not yet have seen the bottom of the market, the price reductions have certainly slowed."

Davidson added that buyers are beginning to recognise value, but a lack of urgency remains the defining feature of higher-end auctions at present.

"Buyers are starting to see some value, however, there is no urgency to jump in just yet,"...

This reminds us of the generational aspect of wealth and resources, as Proverbs 13:22 notes that a good person leaves an inheritance for their children's children. The current market shifts prompt reflection on how...

title.en: A 'child bride' divorced at 20: Meet Australia's youngest divorcees
title.zh: 20岁离异：认识澳大利亚最年轻的离婚者

summary.en: This article introduces young Australians who married and divorced early, noting the similar reasons behind their decisions. It features Natalie Hancock, who grew up in a Pentecostal church in Sydney and married at 19 after meeting her husband through church connections, only to later divorce.
summary.zh: 本文介绍了澳大利亚年轻的离婚者，她们早婚早离，原因惊人地相似。其中一位是娜塔莉·汉考克（Natalie Hancock），她在悉尼的五旬节派教会中长大，19岁结婚，不久后离婚。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

Natalie Hancock was told her entire life that the most important thing a young woman could do was get married.

She grew up in Sydney's Hills District, immersed in her local Pentecostal church, where, by her late teens, her biggest romantic prospect was a boy from church who told her that God had chosen him as an "ordained messenger" and came bearing a message for her: that she should marry him.

But at 19 — while expanding her world at a working holiday program in the UK she soon discovered was something of a scam — Natalie met the man who would become her husband within a year.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They met while working at a pub together: He was the chef and 10 years her senior. Natalie recalls he'd recently arrived from Hungary and barely spoke a word of English, but she was smitten.

"Having grown up firmly rooted in the church, my experience with men — and relationships in general — was pretty stunted."

"I was thrilled — not because I knew it was a good, or even safe, decision; but because I had grown up in a world where getting married was one of, if not the most important thing you could do as a young woman," she says.

Less than a year later, the pair separated, joining the tens of thousands of young Australians who divorce each year.

The latest annual figures from the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) show more married couples divorced in 2025 than the year before: 49,148 divorces were granted — an increase of 4.1 per cent — pushing the national divorce rate to 2.2 per 1,000 people, up from 2.1 in 2024.

The median age at divorce has stayed relatively steady in recent years and sits at 47.3 for men and 44.4 for women.

But dig a little deeper into the data and you'll find a small, easy-to-miss subset: the people who married and divorced young.

In 2025, 775 women aged 16-19 and 11,868 women aged 20-24 got married, compared with 296 and 7,789 men in the same age brackets.

That same year, 458 women aged 16-24 got divorced — an equivalent divorce rate of 0.3 per 1,000 people. Only 170 men in the same age bracket divorced, at a rate of 0.1 per 1,000 people.

It's a narrow slice of the population, but many within it have similar stories to share.

Brenda, whose name has been changed for privacy reasons, was pressured by her family to marry young at the age of 23. Looking back, the now 35-year-old says this stemmed largely from her mixed Lebanese and Greek Catholic background.

"There was an underlying pressure in terms of family, culture, religion and timing. I come from...

reflection.en: The story of Natalie Hancock, married at 19 and divorced by 20, touches on the fragility of early unions often influenced by community expectations. Malachi 2:16 speaks of Yahweh hating divorce and the breaking of faith, a principle that resonates with the pain and brokenness evident in such young lives marked by marital dissolution.
reflection.zh: 娜塔莉·汉考克19岁结婚，20岁离婚的故事，触及了在社群期望影响下早期婚姻的脆弱性。玛拉基书2章16节提到雅伟憎恨离婚和背弃婚约，这原则与如此年轻生命中显现的婚姻破裂的痛苦和破碎产生了共鸣。

summary.en: The One Nation leader, Pauline Hanson, denied receiving funding from Gina Rinehart in February. However, investigative work by The Guardian's Sarah Martin, using flight-tracking data and expense records, has revealed the extent of financial support from Rinehart to Hanson's political party.
summary.zh: “如果你想说我是吉娜·莱因哈特资助的，答案是否定的。” 这是一国党领袖宝琳·汉森在二月份告诉《卫报》资深记者莎拉·马丁的话。然而，《卫报》的马丁通过数月追踪飞行数据和费用记录，揭露了澳大利亚最富有的女性向该国增长最快的政党提供的经济支持的真实程度。

body.en: ‘If you’re trying to say I’m being funded by Gina Rinehart, the answer is no.’ That’s what the One Nation leader, Pauline Hanson, told the Guardian’s senior correspondent Sarah Martin in February. We now know that’s not true. Over months, Martin has pieced together flight-tracking data and expense records to uncover the true extent of financial support flowing from Australia’s richest person to the country’s fastest growing political force. Episode one of The Populist tells the inside story, from the Farrer byelection to the National Press Club, including exclusive new reporting Read more: Pauline Hanson and Barnaby Joyce stayed at Gina Rinehart’s $20m mansion after One Nation fundraisers Continue reading...
body.zh: “如果你想说我得到了吉娜·莱因哈特 (Gina Rinehart) 的资助，那么答案是否定的。”一国党领导人宝琳·汉森 (Pauline Hanson) 在二月份对《卫报》高级记者莎拉·马丁 (Sarah Martin) 说道。我们现在知道那不是真的。几个月来，马丁将航班跟踪数据和费用记录拼凑在一起，以揭示澳大利亚首富向该国增长最快的政治力量提供的财政支持的真实程度。 《民粹主义者》第一集讲述了从法雷尔补选到国家新闻俱乐部的内幕故事，包括独家新报道阅读更多：宝琳·汉森和巴纳比·乔伊斯在一国筹款活动结束后住在吉娜·莱因哈特价值 2000 万美元的豪宅继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of truth, even when complex and requiring diligent investigation, ultimately leads to clarity and freedom. Investigative journalism, like the work detailed here, serves to uncover hidden realities, allowing for a more informed understanding of political and financial dealings.
reflection.zh: 追求真相，即使过程复杂且需要勤奋的调查，最终也会带来清晰和自由。正如这里所详述的，调查性新闻工作有助于揭示隐藏的现实，从而更深入地了解政治和金融交易。

verse.textEn: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.
verse.textZh: 你们必晓得真理，真理必叫你们得以自由。

title.en: 'Living in an online world': Why this state is cutting back on classroom screen time
title.zh: “活在网络世界”：为什么这个州要减少课堂屏幕时间

summary.en: A new policy will limit device usage to as little as 15 minutes per day for younger students, with mandatory implementation from 2028, following similar moves by the Victorian government. This initiative stems from research indicating excessive screen use is problematic, as stated by NSW Education Minister Prue Car.
summary.zh: 一项新政策将限制年幼学生每天使用设备的时间，最少为15分钟，并将于2028年强制实施，此前维多利亚州政府也采取了类似举措。新南威尔士州教育部长普鲁·卡表示，此举源于研究表明过度使用屏幕是一个问题。

body.en:
Students will be forced back to pen and paper as a state government moves to cap daily screen time to as little as 15 minutes against a backdrop of falling test scores.

New South Wales public schools will introduce daily screen-time limits for the start of the 2027 classroom year before the changes become mandatory from 2028 to allow time for teachers to make adjustments.

It follows similar moves from the Victorian government to reduce screen time in the classroom from 2027.

NSW Education Minister Prue Car said government research showed excessive screen use was a problem.

"An entire generation of students are increasingly living in an online world," she said on Sunday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"We have a responsibility to ensure their health and education isn't adversely affected by excessive screen use.

"When the research is telling us teenagers are spending as much as seven hours a day on screens and we are seeing reading and writing skills going backwards for a whole generation of children, we have to act."

Schools are advised to limit screen-based homework, with the use of digital devices not recommended before Year 5.

New state guidelines also recommend at least an hour daily of pen-and-paper learning, citing benefits of handwriting and reading print.

The move follows OECD Programme for International Student Assessment exam results showing Australian high school students registering record-low scores in mathematics and reading.

Australian students spend nearly twice as long using digital devices for learning compared to the OECD average.

Recent National Assessment Program Literacy and Numeracy results mirrored the findings.

About a third of students failed to meet basic benchmarks; reading scores dropped across all grades compared to the previous year, and only Year 5 students showed writing improvement.

Under the NSW policy, daily screen time limits — averaged across a school week — will be set at 15 minutes for kindergarten to Year 2, 30 minutes for Years 3–4 and 45 minutes for Years 5–6.

High school students are capped at one-quarter of class time per subject in Years 7–10 and up to half in Years 11–12.

There will be exemptions and adjustments for students with disability, those with additional needs, or students for whom English is not their first language, or where digital support is part of a personalised learning plan.

NSW Health chief paediatrician Helen Goodwin said it was important to limit screen time for children.

"A healthy day for children and young people includes a mix of being active, getting enough sleep, and building active social connections with their...
body.zh: 在考试成绩下降的背景下，州政府将每天的屏幕时间限制在 15 分钟，学生们将被迫重新使用笔和纸。 新南威尔士州公立学校将从 2027 学年开始引入每日屏幕时间限制，然后从 2028 年起强制实施，以便教师有时间进行调整。 此前，维多利亚州政府也采取了类似举措，从 2027 年起减少课堂上的屏幕时间。 新州教育部长 Prue Car 表示，政府研究表明过度使用屏幕是一个问题。 “整整一代学生越来越多地生活在网络世界中，”她周日表示。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我们有责任确保他们的健康和教育不会因过度使用屏幕而受到不利影响。 “当研究告诉我们青少年每天在屏幕上花费多达七个小时，并且我们看到整整一代孩子的阅读和写作技能在倒退时，我们必须采取行动。” 建议学校限制基于屏幕的家庭作业，并且不建议在五年级之前使用数字设备。 新的州指南还建议每天至少进行一小时的纸笔学习，并列举了手写和阅读印刷品的好处。 此前，经合组织国际学生评估计划考试结果显示，澳大利亚高中生的数学和阅读成绩创下历史新低。 与经合组织平均水平相比，澳大利亚学生使用数字设备进行学习的时间几乎是其两倍。 最近的国家读写和算术评估计划结果也反映了这一发现。 大约三分之一的学生未能达到基本标准；与上一年相比，所有年级的阅读成绩都有所下降，只有五年级学生的写作成绩有所提高。 根据新南威尔士州的政策，幼儿园至二年级的每日屏幕时间限制（整个学校周的平均时间）将被设定为 15 分钟，3-4 年级为 30 分钟，5-6 年级为 45 分钟。 高中生 7 至 10 年级每个科目的上课时间上限为四分之一，11 至 12 年级则上限为一半。 对于残疾学生、有额外需求的学生、英语不是母语的学生，或者数字支持是个性化学习计划一部分的学生，将会有豁免和调整。 新南威尔士州卫生局首席儿科医生海伦·古德温表示，限制儿童看屏幕的时间很重要。 “对于儿童和年轻人来说，健康的一天包括活跃、充足的睡眠以及与他们的……建立积极的社交联系。

reflection.en: As New South Wales schools move to limit screen time for young learners, the focus shifts back to foundational methods like pen and paper. This reflects a growing awareness that while technology offers much, the core task of forming young minds requires careful balance and intentionality, ensuring that educational tools serve, rather than hinder,...
reflection.zh: 随着新南威尔士州学校开始限制幼儿学习者使用屏幕的时间，焦点又回到了纸笔等基础教学方法上。这反映出一种日益增长的认识：尽管科技提供了许多便利，但塑造年轻心灵的核心任务需要仔细的平衡和深思熟虑，以确保教育工具能够促进而非阻碍其发展。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: Hong Kong’s iPhone scam: how to protect your credit card from online fraud
title.zh: 香港的iPhone诈骗：如何保护您的信用卡免受在线欺诈

summary.en: Over 700 residents in Hong Kong were victims of a credit card scam over the weekend, with their cards used for unauthorized purchases of the new iPhone 18 Pro series. While banks assured victims they would not be held liable for fraudulent transactions made with due care, the incident has raised significant concerns...
summary.zh: 上周末，香港有超过700名居民成为信用卡诈骗的受害者，他们的信用卡被用于未经授权购买新款iPhone 18 Pro系列手机。尽管银行向受害者保证，只要信用卡得到妥善保管且交易被证明未经授权，他们将不会承担责任，但此次事件引发了对信用卡安全问题的广泛担忧。

Although banks reassured victims they would not be charged as long as the cards were used with due care and the transactions were proven to be unauthorised, the incident still caused widespread concern over credit card security. The South China Morning Post asked information technology experts for practical tips on...
body.zh: 周末，超过 700 名香港人震惊地发现，他们的信用卡被用来未经授权订购苹果新款 iPhone 18 Pro 系列手机。尽管银行向受害者保证，只要谨慎使用卡并证明交易未经授权，就不会被收取费用，但该事件仍然引起了人们对信用卡安全的广泛担忧。 《南华早报》向信息技术专家询问了有关……的实用技巧。

This incident, where over 700 individuals in Hong Kong had their credit cards compromised for unauthorized phone purchases, underscores how the pursuit of wealth can lead to harmful actions. It serves as a stark reminder that the love of...
reflection.zh: 最新科技的诱惑，比如新款iPhone，不幸地可能成为那些寻求不法之财者的诱饵。此次事件中，香港有超过700人的信用卡被盗用以未经授权购买手机，这凸显了对财富的追求如何会导致有害行为。它也警示我们，对金钱的贪爱确实是万恶之源，通过欺诈和恐惧影响了许多人的生活。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Ten SAR wushu athletes to compete at Asian Games
